title: ChatGPT
short_description: Bring your Attio CRM into ChatGPT

content.overview:
Access Attio directly from ChatGPT for your go-to-market work. The Attio connector brings your CRM into ChatGPT so you can prep for your next meeting, draft the follow-up email, and quickly find the answers you need without leaving the chat.

Ask a question and get a real answer, grounded in your live Attio workspace. Need to write a personalized outreach email, summarize what happened on a call, or research an account before a meeting? ChatGPT pulls the context straight from Attio and writes alongside you.

Because ChatGPT works with your live data, every answer reflects your actual workspace, not a stale export. And because your Attio permissions carry over, ChatGPT only ever sees what you can see.
content.how_it_works:
Once connected, ChatGPT can:

- **Research accounts and contacts**, like "Tell me everything we know about Stripe and who our main contacts are there."
- **Draft personalized outreach**, like "Write a follow-up email to Sarah at Notion based on our last meeting notes."
- **Summarize calls and meetings**, like "Summarize the key points from my last three discovery calls with Acme Corp."
- **Prep for meetings**, like "Give me a brief on Linear before my call tomorrow, including recent activity and open opportunities."
- **Search your pipeline**, like "Which Series B companies in our pipeline are based in New York?"
- **Log notes and tasks**, like "Add a note to Acme Corp saying they're interested in enterprise pricing, and create a follow-up task for next Tuesday."
- **Surface insights from calls**, like "What pricing objections have come up in my recent call recordings?"
content.configure:
From this page:

1. Click **Install** to go to the ChatGPT connector. (you need to be logged in to ChatGPT)
2. Click **Connect**.
3. Click **Sign in with Attio**. Login with Attio if not already logged in.
4. You will be redirected to Attio. Login with Attio if not already logged in.
5. Select your workspace and click **Confirm**.
6. You can now use Attio in ChatGPT.

From [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com):

1. Go to **Apps**.
2. Search for **Attio** and open it.
3. Click **Connect**. 
4. Click **Sign in with Attio**.
5. You will be redirected to Attio. Login with Attio if not already logged in.
6. Select your workspace and click **Confirm**.
7. You can now use Attio in ChatGPT.

title: Pylon
short_description: Sync Attio CRM data into Pylon for full customer context

content.overview: Bring your Attio CRM into Pylon and give your team, and its agents, full account context on every customer interaction. Companies, people, and attributes sync automatically, keeping Pylon's context layer always up to date.
content.how_it_works:
* **Field sync**: Companies, people, and attributes sync between Attio and Pylon in both directions. Fields from Attio become available across Pylon's filters, triggers, and macros, giving agents the account context they need to investigate and resolve customer work faster.
* **Contact sync**: When a new contact reaches out in a prospect or customer channel, Pylon automatically adds them to Attio and links them to the right Account, so your CRM stays current without manual entry.
* **Activity sync**: Pylon scans customer conversations daily, uses AI to summarize what's happening, and syncs those summaries back to the relevant Company in Attio, keeping your CRM up to date with support context.
* **Smarter workflows**: Use Attio fields to filter and target broadcasts, and to view and filter issues by account data, so your team can act on the right signals at the right time.
content.configure:
1. From your Pylon dashboard, open the App Directory and select the Attio integration.
2. Click Connect and authenticate your Attio workspace to link your account.
3. Set up field sync by choosing which fields sync from Attio to Pylon and from Pylon to Attio. Synced fields become available across Pylon filters, triggers, and macros.
4. Enable contact sync so new contacts in your prospect and customer channels are automatically added to Attio and linked to the right Account.
5. Enable activity sync so Pylon's daily AI-generated conversation summaries sync to the corresponding Company in Attio.
6. Use your synced Attio fields to filter and target broadcasts, and to view and filter issues by account data.

content.overview:
Notion is the connected workspace where teams write docs, manage projects and build databases. This app brings Notion into your Attio workflows, so the pages and databases your team relies on stay in sync with your CRM automatically.

Use it to turn activity in Attio into structured content in Notion: spin up a project page when a deal is won, log a new row in a Notion database for every company added to a list, or append meeting notes to an existing page. Everything runs as part of your Attio workflows, with no copy-and-paste and no switching tabs.
content.how_it_works:
## MCP

Use the Notion MCP inside workflow custom agents and allow agents to read context from Notion.

**Please note**: MCP tools within custom agents are read only at this point in time.

## Workflows

### Create page

Creates a new page nested inside an existing Notion page. Choose the parent page and set a title, then use the new page's ID and URL in later steps.

### Create page in database

Adds a new row to a Notion database and fills in its properties. Pick the database and the app loads its property schema for you, so you can map Attio data to the right fields.

Supported property types include text, URL, number, checkbox, date, email, phone number, select, status, multi-select and people.

### Add content to page

Appends or prepends rich text to an existing Notion page — ideal for logging notes, summaries or updates onto a page over time. Choose whether content lands at the start or end of the page.
content.configure:
### Workflows

#### Create a Notion connector

1. Click a **New connection** in [the Notion developer portal](https://app.notion.com/developers/connections).
2. Select the **Access token** authentication method.
3. Mark the connector as installable in your chosen workspace.
4. Enable all content capabilities for the connector.

**Store the token in Attio**

1. Head to the Notion app in your workspace settings.
2. Under **Workspace connection**, click **Connect.**
3. Paste in the access token copied from your Notion connector.

**Add the connector to your chosen Notion pages**

1. Open the settings menu at the top right of your chosen Notion page(s).
2. Click **Connections → Manage connections →Add connections**  
3. Search for your connection and add it to the page

### MCP

1. Head to the Notion app in your workspace settings.
2. Under **Member connections**, click **Connect**.
3. Complete the authentication flow to grant Attio access to the Notion MCP.

title: Leadjourney
short_description: Ad attribution for your Attio CRM

content.overview:
LeadJourney is an ad-attribution platform that ties every conversion back to the marketing channel, campaign, and ad that drove it.

Connect Attio to LeadJourney and your CRM record events — new people, new deals, deal stage changes, won opportunities — start flowing into LeadJourney as conversions. Every Attio record is automatically matched back to the original click\_id, ad, and campaign that generated it, so you can finally answer questions like "which Google Ads campaign produced the deals that closed last month?" or "what's the true CAC by channel including downstream Attio pipeline?"

Built for B2B teams running paid acquisition on Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, or any other ad platform — and using Attio as their source of truth for revenue.
content.how_it_works:
After you connect your Attio workspace through OAuth, LeadJourney registers a per-workspace webhook subscription on the events you care about (Record Created, Record Updated) for the objects you choose (People, Deals, Companies).

When a matching record event fires in Attio, LeadJourney:

1. Verifies the webhook signature using the per-subscription secret.

2. Fetches the full record from Attio's API (and the associated person on Deal events).

3. Runs your trigger's field-mapping rules to extract identity (email, phone, click\_id) and revenue.

4. Applies any filters you've configured (e.g. only fire when stage = Won).

5. Dispatches a conversion event into the same attribution pipeline used by every other channel, which matches it against tracked clicks and updates ad-platform performance dashboards.

Everything runs in seconds. Deduplication is handled per-event so Attio's retry semantics never produce double-counted conversions.

title: Outdoo AI

content.overview:
[Outdoo AI](https://www.outdoo.ai/) is an enterprise AI roleplay and coaching platform for customer-facing teams. It helps teams turn training into real execution by connecting roleplay practice, live customer conversations, and post-call workflows. With Outdoo, reps can practice realistic scenarios, receive AI-powered feedback, and improve performance, while managers can coach more effectively and drive measurable revenue outcomes.

The Attio and Outdoo AI integration helps customer-facing teams keep CRM records accurate, capture key meeting insights, and improve rep performance through AI-powered coaching and roleplay.

title: Etropo
short_description: Modern and efficient way to manage your marketing budget.

content.how_it_works:
Connect Attio to Etropo to see which campaigns actually drive revenue.

Etropo pulls deal data from your Attio pipeline and attributes it to campaigns. You see conversion counts and revenue directly alongside your campaign spend - no manual tracking, no spreadsheet lookups.

**Use cases:**

- **Measure true ROI** - See cost per acquisition and revenue per campaign in one view
- **Attribute pipeline to source** - Filter by UTM parameters to know which channels generate deals
- **Track full funnel** - Monitor leads, qualified opportunities, or closed-won revenue per campaign

Marketing spend and sales outcomes in the same place.

title: Segmetrics
short_description: Uncover the hidden profit in every part of your funnel

content.overview:
Get 100% clarity on where your leads come from, how they act, and how much your marketing is really worth. Get a handle on the KPIs that matter most for your marketing funnels.

Built by marketers, for marketers. SegMetrics brings all your data into one place, simplifying lead and revenue attribution across all of your customers’ devices.
content.how_it_works:
SegMetrics gives you the ability to analyze your marketing campaign performance by connecting Attio with other data sources. With that information, you can easily segment that data into your leads, find the automation triggers that convert to customers, understand where your most valuable leads are coming from, and more.

In as little as ten minutes, SegMetrics lets you:

- Connect all your marketing data
- Find where your most valuable leads are coming from
- Understand your customer journey
- Build easy-to-understand dashboards
- Get actionable next steps on how to improve your marketing
content.configure:

- This will open the Activation window, which is where you will be prompted to connect.

title: GeoMaps
short_description: Turn your Attio CRM into an interactive map

content.overview:
GeoMaps turns your Attio workspace into an interactive map, with no GIS skills required. It places your people, companies, deals and custom objects on a live map that stays in sync with Attio. From there you can filter and colour-code records by any attribute, find what's nearby, plan optimized multi-stop routes, draw territories and drive-time areas, build heatmaps and publish shareable, embeddable maps.

It works both ways: edit a record on the map or in the table and the change is saved in Attio. Reps in the field use the GeoMaps mobile app (iOS and Android) to navigate to customers, update records and check in after a visit, with the visit note saved on the Attio record. It's built for sales, field and operations teams who want to see and act on their Attio data geographically.
content.configure:
To use this app you need a GeoMaps account. It starts with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Setup takes a couple of minutes:

1. Create or log in to your GeoMaps account at app.geomaps.co.

2. Open Data Sources, choose Attio and click Connect Attio.

3. Sign in to your Attio workspace and approve the access GeoMaps asks for.

4. Choose the Attio objects you want to map (e.g. People, Companies, Deals) and confirm the address field. GeoMaps imports and geocodes them onto an interactive map.

Already connected before November 2026? Reconnect once (Data Sources → your Attio source → Settings → Reconnect) to allow check-in notes. Until then, check-ins are kept in GeoMaps only.

No coding or GIS experience is required.

short_description: Stop guessing how messy your Attio is

title: DemandSense
short_description: Trace how your Linkedin Ads grow revenue impact in Attio

content.overview:
**Know Exactly What Drives Revenue** 
Most B2B marketers can't connect LinkedIn ad spend to closed deals. DemandSense reads deals, companies, and contacts from Attio to show which campaigns influenced pipeline and revenue, with configurable attribution windows from 3 to 12 months. Prove LinkedIn ROI to leadership with real numbers, not click reports.
content.how_it_works:
DemandSense integrates with Attio CRM to give B2B marketers full control over their LinkedIn Ads, clear visibility into which accounts engage, and direct attribution of ad spend to pipeline and revenue, all using the CRM data you already trust.

title: Schema Map
short_description: See your whole Attio schema as one clear, live diagram

content.overview:
Schema Map turns your Attio workspace into one interactive diagram. Every object, list and attribute is shown as a box, and clear arrows show how records connect between them.

It is built for admins, RevOps teams and consultants who need to understand a workspace fast: before a cleanup, when onboarding a new team member, or when planning changes to the data model.

You can open any object to see its custom and system attributes, check how often each attribute is actually filled in, and leave comments and notes so your team knows why things exist.
content.how_it_works:
Schema Map reads your workspace structure from Attio: objects, lists, attributes and how they link to each other. It does not change anything in your workspace.

1. Open Apps > Schema Map in Attio and click Generate ERD.

2. Click Open ERD to see the diagram in a new tab. Hover any box to highlight its links, or click it to see all its attributes.

3. Arrows follow the records: A → B means B picks a record from A. Two way relationships show arrows on both ends, and dashed lines show records added to a list.

4. Click Refresh on the Schema Map page in Attio whenever your schema changes.

For the attribute usage check, Schema Map reads 200 random records per attribute and shows what percent have a value. Only the counts and percentages are saved, never the record data itself.

title: Arka Analytics
short_description: Copilot & Analytics for Attio

content.overview:
Arka Analytics is an AI-native analytics platform that lets you explore, visualize, and ask questions across your Attio CRM data in seconds.

Instead of exporting data or building custom reports, Arka automatically turns your Attio objects into live dashboards and lets you query them using natural language. You can analyze pipeline health, account engagement, deal velocity, revenue trends, and relationship data—without writing SQL or setting up models.

Arka is built for modern teams that want fast, self-serve insights across sales, revenue, and go-to-market data, while maintaining enterprise-grade security and control.
content.how_it_works:
Once connected, Arka Analytics securely syncs selected data from Attio and makes it immediately available for analysis.

Arka can sync and analyze:

- Companies, people, and custom objects
- Deals, pipelines, and stages
- Activities, notes, and relationship data
- Timestamps, owners, and lifecycle fields

After syncing, Arka:

1. Automatically generates dashboards and metrics from your Attio data
2. Lets you ask questions in plain English (e.g. *“Which deals stalled last quarter?”*)
3. Combines structured CRM data with unstructured data (notes, descriptions, activity logs)
4. Keeps dashboards up to date as your Attio data changes

No manual modeling, exports, or maintenance required.
content.configure:
To use this integration, you’ll need an active **Arka Analytics** account.

Setup steps:

1. Sign in to your Arka Analytics workspace
2. From Arka, add **Attio** as a data source
3. Authenticate your Attio account and select the objects you want to sync
4. Arka will automatically ingest the data and generate dashboards

Once connected, your Attio data is available instantly for dashboards, analysis, and natural-language queries inside Arka.

All data access follows Attio permissions and is encrypted in transit and at rest. For organizations with stricter security requirements, Arka also supports self-hosted deployments where data remains entirely within your own infrastructure.

title: CompCode
short_description: Commission tracking for every deal

content.overview:
CompCode is a commission management platform that brings real-time commission tracking directly into Attio. When deals close, CompCode automatically calculates commissions based on your plan rules - tiered rates, accelerators, flat bonuses, and milestone payouts.

The embedded deal widget shows earned commissions for won deals and forecasted commissions for open pipeline, including current attainment, applicable tier, and rate. Reps and managers can click through to the full CompCode dashboard for statements, team views, and period breakdowns.

CompCode is the only commission platform with native Attio integration. Plans are configured via API or the built-in AI plan builder - no spreadsheets, no manual calculation, no 6-week implementation.
content.how_it_works:
CompCode syncs the following data from Attio:

 • Deal records: amount, stage, close date, and custom fields for commission calculation

 • Deal owners: mapped as commission reps with automatic role assignment

 • Workspace members: synced for team visibility and dashboard access

When a deal stage changes, Attio sends a webhook to CompCode. The commission engine evaluates the deal against assigned plan rules and calculates earnings in real time. Results appear in the Attio deal widget and the CompCode dashboard.

Commission events are stored in an immutable audit ledger - every payout is traceable back to the plan rule that generated it.  CompCode generates commission statements for each rep per period - line-by-line breakdowns of every deal, rate, and payout. Managers and finance can review, approve, and export statements directly from the dashboard. Approved statements are locked and versioned, creating a clear audit trail for payroll and accounting.
content.configure:
CompCode is free for teams with up to 10 reps. No credit card required.

1. Install CompCode and authorize the Attio connection via OAuth              
2. CompCode automatically registers a webhook and syncs your reps
3. Create a commission plan using the REST API
4. Assign reps to the plan and set quota targets
5. Calculate commission for all currently eligible deals. 
6. Commissions calculate automatically when deals close in Attio                                                       

Setup takes under 10 minutes. Full documentation at [compcode.ai/docs](http://compcode.ai/docs)

title: PromptQL
short_description: Multiplayer AI with wiki

content.overview:
PromptQL is an AI-powered data platform that lets teams connect databases and SaaS tools to have natural language conversations with an AI assistant. Ask questions, get answers with charts and tables, and build shared organizational knowledge.

Connect Attio to analyze your CRM data, track deals, and get insights across your sales pipeline. Surface call recordings and meeting activity to identify stalled deals. Query notes and comments for team context before meetings. Create follow-up tasks and update deal stages without leaving PromptQL.
content.how_it_works:
PromptQL connects to Attio via OAuth to securely access your workspace data. Once connected, you can ask the AI assistant questions in natural language like:

- "Show me all deals closing this month"
- "Which companies haven't been contacted in 30 days?"
- "Summarize recent calls with Acme Corp"
- "What tasks are overdue on my pipeline?"
- "What's the latest note on the Microsoft deal?"

The AI queries your Attio data in real-time — records, lists, comments, notes, meetings, call recordings, tasks, and files — and presents results as tables, charts, or written summaries. It can also take action: update deal stages, add notes, and create tasks.
content.configure:
How to connect:

1. Sign up or log into PromptQL at [https://prompt.ql.app](https://prompt.ql.app/)
2. Navigate to "Data" in the left sidebar
3. Click "Add Integration" and select Attio
4. Authorize access via OAuth when prompted
5. Start asking questions about your Attio data!

PromptQL requests read access to your records, companies, people, deals, lists and notes. Write access is included for CRM workflows like creating records, updating deal stages and adding notes.

title: First Distro
short_description: Prevent churn. Increase retention.

content.overview: Your CRM shows what happened. FirstDistro shows what's about to happen. By analyzing customer behavior patterns, FirstDistro predicts churn risk, identifies expansion opportunities, and delivers actionable insights directly into Attio. Stop losing customers you could have saved—start every day knowing exactly where to focus.
content.how_it_works:
FirstDistro syncs two custom attributes to your Attio Company records:

- Health Score (0-100): A dynamic score based on product usage, milestone completion, and engagement patterns.

- Risk Level (Healthy, At-Risk, Critical): A categorical status for quick filtering and prioritization.

- Trend (Steady, Improving, Declining): Direction of health over time.

- Primary Risk: The top reason driving the current risk status.

- Last Synced: Timestamp of the most recent update.

Records are matched by domain. Scores update automatically as customer behavior changes.
content.configure:
Connect FirstDistro to Attio:

 1. In FirstDistro, go to Settings → Integrations.

 2. Click Connect on the Attio card and authorize access.

Display Health Data in Attio:

 1. Open your Companies table in Attio.

 2. Click + Add column.

 3. Add: Health Score, Risk Level, Trend, Primary Risk, and Last Synced.

 4. Sort or filter by Risk Level to prioritize at-risk accounts.

Syncing begins automatically—no further setup required.

title: DigitalPilot
short_description: The attribution platform for B2B SMBs

content.overview: DigitalPilot is an attribution platform for B2B SMBs running paid campaigns. It identifies which companies visit your site from which ads, so you can see exactly which campaigns drive qualified leads.

title: Permute
short_description: AI-native executive intelligence and automations platform

content.overview: Permute is an AI agent platform for finance and operations teams that connects to your Attio CRM to automatically surface insights, identify trends, and automate reporting across your pipeline and relationships — normalizing your CRM data alongside financials, spreadsheets, and documents so teams can ask complex questions in plain English and deploy automated workflows in minutes, not weeks.
content.how_it_works: Once connected, Permute reads your Attio workspace and syncs everything it needs to power AI analysis: all of your CRM objects (Companies, People, Deals, and any custom objects you've created) with their full attribute history, plus Notes, Tasks, and Workspace Members. Your data is never modified — Permute is strictly read-only and uses OAuth 2.0 so you stay in full control of access.
content.configure: From your Permute workspace, navigate to Connectors, find Attio, and click "Connect." You'll be redirected to Attio to sign in and authorize access via OAuth — no API keys or manual configuration required. Once authorized, Permute automatically discovers your workspace objects and begins syncing your data.

title: Falora
short_description: Control Your Growth

content.overview:
Falora connects ad experiment performance to CRM pipeline data. The Attio integration lets Falora read your deal pipeline and match contacts to ad experiments via UTM tags - so you can see which experiments actually generate leads, MQLs, SQLs, and revenue.

Falora never stores contact information. During each sync, Falora reads contacts and deals from Attio, counts how many reached each pipeline stage per experiment, and writes only the aggregated numbers back to its own database. No names, emails, or personal data leave your Attio workspace.

title: Hey Sid
short_description: See the pipeline your campaigns influenced

Hey Sid is account-based marketing for B2B companies. Sid finds the companies that fit your ideal customer profile, runs ad campaigns aimed at them, and shows you which of them engaged.

Connect Attio and Hey Sid brings your CRM data into that picture, so you can see the pipeline and revenue your campaigns influenced.
content.how_it_works:
### Your Attio data in Hey Sid

Hey Sid connects to your Attio workspace and matches your records to the companies in your Sid audiences.

See which deals come from companies your Sid campaigns reached, and how much pipeline and revenue they add up to, on the Insights page in Hey Sid.

title: Improvado
short_description: Ask your AI Agent questions across Attio + ad data

content.overview:
Improvado is the AI-powered marketing analytics and intelligence platform that Fortune 500 companies and global agencies use to consolidate their entire marketing data stack. title: Productbet
short_description: ProductBet connects your existing tools and uses AI to find

content.overview: Productbet is a product analytics tool for product manager that connected all your data sources, and helps you find signals in your data for what to build next to help the customer. title: Supercurve
short_description: Your AI marketing teammate for your Attio pipeline

content.overview:
Supercurve is an AI marketing analyst that reads your whole stack, from traffic and search to paid ads and your CRM, and tells you what to do next. The Attio app brings your pipeline into that picture.

Once connected, Supercurve mirrors your deals, companies and people from Attio (read-only) and gives you a Pipeline page beside your other analytics: open pipeline by stage, closed won, win rate and new people, each with a trend and a breakdown. Click any deal to see its stage history, the people on the account and the notes, tasks and meetings your team logged in Attio.

Because the pipeline sits next to your marketing data, Curve (Supercurve's assistant) can answer questions like "which channels are feeding deals that close" or "what moved in the pipeline this week", flag deals that have gone quiet, and build a lookalike audience export from the people on accounts you have won.

Supercurve never writes to Attio. It reads with the scopes you grant and nothing else.
content.configure:
You will need a Supercurve workspace on a plan that includes CRM integrations (see supercurve.ai/pricing) and an Attio account with permission to install apps in the workspace.

In Attio, the Deals object must be enabled (Settings, Objects) for pipeline metrics; companies and people sync either way. Won and lost outcomes are derived from your stage names and the celebration setting on each status. If your pipeline uses unusual names, Supercurve shows which stages it treated as won or lost so you can check.

No API keys and no fields to map: the OAuth approval is the whole setup. To reconnect after revoking access in Attio, click Reconnect on the Attio card in Supercurve.

title: FunnelStory

FunnelStory is a Customer Success and Revenue Intelligence platform that helps B2B SaaS teams eliminate surprise churn and drive net revenue retention.

By combining product usage signals, communication data, and CRM context, FunnelStory creates a 360-degree view of your customer health. This integration connects your Attio CRM data directly to FunnelStory, ensuring your customer success and sales teams always have the most up-to-date account context, revenue metrics, and stakeholder information without manual data entry.
content.how_it_works:
FunnelStory will sync the following data from Attio to build a comprehensive Customer Intelligence Graph:

- Companies: FunnelStory imports Company records to map your accounts, including firmographic details (e.g., ARR, employee count, industry) and account status.

title: Pipedream

content.how_it_works: Integrate with Pipedream to easily build and run workflows with the Attio API. Choose from thousands of pre-configured actions and triggers across 2,400+ different apps, or write custom code to easily build your own integration.

title: Spiich

title: Asana
short_description: Create Asana tasks and projects from Attio workflows

content.overview: Asana is a work management platform used by teams to plan, track, and organize tasks and projects. This integration connects Attio to Asana so you can turn CRM activity into action — automatically create Asana tasks and projects as part of your Attio workflows, without switching tools.
content.how_it_works:
Once connected, Asana adds two workflow steps you can drop into any Attio workflow:

- **Create task**: Creates an Asana task with a name, workspace, and privacy setting, and optionally links it to one or more projects. The created task's ID is passed on to later workflow steps.
- **Create project**: Creates an Asana project with a name and workspace, plus optional start/due dates, an owner, a color, an icon, and access-level settings. The created project's ID is passed on to later workflow steps.
- **Create project from template**: Creates a project from an existing Asana project template, so the new project inherits the template's structure. If the template schedules tasks relative to a date, you set that date on the step; if the template defines roles, you can assign each role to a specific workspace member.
content.configure:
1. Add the Asana app from the Attio App Store. 
2. Connect your Asana account when prompted — you'll be asked to sign in and authorize Attio.
3. Open a workflow and add the Create task or Create project step.
4. Select an Asana workspace, then fill in the task or project details. Project and user pickers become available once a workspace is selected.
5. Save your workflow. Each run will create the task or project in Asana automatically.

title: ClickUp
short_description: Create ClickUp lists and tasks straight from Attio

content.overview: ClickUp is a task and project management tool organized around Workspaces, Spaces, Folders, and Lists. This integration connects Attio to ClickUp so your team can turn CRM activity into project work automatically, without switching tools or copying details by hand. Once connected, any Attio workflow can create ClickUp lists and tasks directly, keeping sales and delivery teams working from the same information.
content.how_it_works:
**Create list** creates a new ClickUp list, either directly in a Space or nested inside a Folder.

**Create task** creates a task in any ClickUp list, with support for assignees, user groups, priority, due and start dates, a time estimate, sprint points, and links to parent or dependent tasks.
content.configure: Connect your ClickUp account from the workflow step's authentication prompt. Each Attio workspace member connects with their own ClickUp login, so lists and tasks created through the integration are attributed to the person who owns the connection. Once connected, add a Create list or Create task step to any workflow, choose the ClickUp Workspace, Space, and Folder (or List) you want to use, and fill in the remaining fields. No additional setup is required inside ClickUp itself.

title: Klavis AI

You can use the Strata MCP Server for multiple integrations or Individual Integration for focused Attio-only applications. The platform handles authentication, API rate limits, and error handling automatically, allowing your applications to search and create records without technical complexity.

title: Den
short_description: AI Connected Workspace

content.overview: Den is a collaborative workspace that seamlessly combines document editing, messaging, and project management in one intuitive platform.
content.how_it_works: When you connect Den to Attio, your team can collaborate on documents, messaging, and project management tasks while maintaining visibility into your customer data. Team members can reference Attio records during conversations, access customer context while editing documents, and coordinate project activities with full CRM integration.
content.configure:
1. Navigate to the Attio App Store and select Den from the available integrations.
2. Authenticate your Den workspace by logging into your account through the secure connection flow.
3. Access your Den dashboard, navigate to Integrations, and select Attio to complete setup.

title: Slite
short_description: AI Search on your Attio data + all your company tools

content.overview: Super’s Attio integration transforms how you access and leverage your CRM data, enabling instant answers across your entire customer database without switching tools, and with the rest of your team data.
content.how_it_works:
Slite connects to your Attio workspace through a simple OAuth authentication process that respects existing permissions. After granting access, you can select which lists or objects you want to index, and refine which specific fields should be searchable.

The integration indexes up to 100 properties per object for comprehensive metadata searching. Field descriptions are used for semantic content understanding, while notes and threads attached to records are also fully indexed to provide complete context.
content.configure:
From your Slite dashboard, navigate to the Data Sources section and select Attio from the available integrations. You’ll need administrator access to both Slite and Attio to complete the connection.

After authenticating via the OAuth popup, you’ll be able to select which objects or lists you want to index from your Attio workspace, and refine which specific fields are indexed to improve question relevance. Slite will automatically respect existing Attio permissions, ensuring private lists remain accessible only to authorized users.

title: Okta
short_description: Provides Oauth2 configuration for SCIM in Okta

content.overview: SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) lets you manage Attio workspace membership directly from your identity provider (IDP). When SCIM is configured, your identity provider can be used to manage workspace membership in Attio. Adding someone in your IDP provisions them in Attio, and removing them suspends their access.
content.configure:
You will need to be on the Entreprise plan and be a workspace admin to set up SCIM.

This app is directly integrated with the Attio app from the Okta store used for SCIM provisioning. Oauth2 is configured via this app to provide a limited-scoped token to the Attio app in Okta. In order to generate a token, follow those steps:

1. From the Okta app, navigate to Provisioning > Integration
2. Click on "Authenticate with Attio". This will open up a page for you to login with Attio. After login, you will see a request to give the app access to a workspace.
3. Make sure that you select the workspace that you want to integrate with SCIM. Click Confirm.

title: Jet Admin
short_description: No-Code Web App Builder

content.overview:
Jet Admin integrates seamlessly with Attio, allowing you to build custom internal tools, dashboards, and workflows on top of your CRM data — without writing code. After connecting Attio, you can instantly access your records, enrich them with custom views, and create powerful interfaces using Jet’s drag-and-drop builder. Visualize contacts, companies, and interactions in real time through tables, kanban boards, charts, and more.

You can also automate key processes by creating workflows that update Attio data, send notifications, or trigger actions across other connected services. With granular user permissions, you control who can view or edit specific CRM objects, ensuring secure collaboration across your team. Whether you want a lightweight CRM, a client portal, or a fully tailored relationship management workspace, Jet Admin helps you customize Attio data into streamlined, user-friendly tools that fit your exact business needs.
content.how_it_works:
Jet Admin works by connecting to your data sources and letting you build custom tools visually — without coding. Here’s how it works step-by-step:

1. **Connect your data**
Link databases, APIs, or SaaS tools like Attio, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and more. Jet automatically syncs and structures your data.
2. **Build interfaces visually**
Use the drag-and-drop builder to create pages, dashboards, forms, and tables on top of your connected data.
3. **Add logic & automations**
Define actions, workflows, and conditions to update data, trigger notifications, or integrate with other services.
4. **Control access**
Set granular permissions so each teammate or customer sees only the data they should.
5. **Launch & share**
Publish your app and share it internally or externally as a secure tool or portal.
content.configure:
1. Create your app
2. Connect Attio as your data source
3. Build pages and automations to streamline workflows
4. Publish and share your App

title: Arcade.dev
short_description: Securely connect AI agents to Attio

content.overview:
[Arcade.dev](http://Arcade.dev) provides production-ready authentication infrastructure for AI agents. With this integration, AI agents can securely read, create, and update records in your Attio workspace (people, companies, deals, notes, and custom objects) without compromising security or requiring manual API key management.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Arcade handles the hard parts of agent-to-app authentication: OAuth flows, token management, and granular permissions.
content.how_it_works:
Once installed, Arcade connects to your Attio workspace via OAuth. When an AI agent needs to interact with your CRM data, Arcade authenticates the request on behalf of the user, enforces permissions, and executes the action in Attio.

Works with any MCP-compatible client - Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, custom agents - or any other tool that supports the protocol. Supported actions include reading and searching records, creating new entries, updating existing data, and adding notes. All requests are authenticated per-user, so you maintain full audit trails and can revoke access anytime.
content.configure:
Sign in to [Arcade.dev](http://Arcade.dev) using Google or email. Search for "Attio" in the toolkit catalog and add it to your MCP gateway. 

When you  first use an Attio tool, you'll be prompted to authorize access to your workspace via OAuth. Once connected, your AI agents can read, create, and update Attio records immediately.

title: Journeybee

content.overview:
JourneyBee is a partner relationship management platform that integrates with Attio to streamline partner collaboration, onboarding, and revenue generation. The platform consolidates partner data within Attio, automates lead matching, and runs end-to-end engagement workflows. Sales teams get real-time partner intelligence directly in their Attio CRM for true co-selling and a single source of truth for partnership revenue.

Authorize the OAuth connection when prompted

Your contacts and companies will be available for audience targeting in the Campaign IDE

title: Civic IQ
short_description: Intent Signals for Gov Sellers

content.overview: Civic IQ gives vendors a smarter way to sell into the public sector by turning hard-to-find local government signals into actionable go-to-market intelligence.
content.how_it_works: Civic IQ seamlessly syncs signals data directly into your CRM system through a secure OAuth connection with Attio. title: Sembly AI
short_description: Turn meetings into CRM notes, tasks & contacts

content.overview:
Sembly AI brings meeting intelligence into Attio so your CRM stays accurate and up to date. Automatically sync AI-generated meeting summaries, decisions, and action items to the right Attio records (People, Companies, and more), using meeting participants and context to keep everything connected.

Instead of manual note-taking and copy-paste, your team gets a consistent meeting trail inside Attio—perfect for Sales, Customer Success, Recruiting, and internal stakeholder meetings. Choose what to share (summary only, action items, full transcript) and keep your workspace aligned on what was actually discussed.
content.how_it_works:

- Choose which meetings should sync (e.g., your meetings, meetings you attended, selected calendars, or specific criteria set by your workflow).
- After a meeting, Sembly AI generates structured outputs (Notes,, transcript, task).
- The integration matches meeting participants to Attio records (typically by email) and attaches the selected content to the relevant records.
content.configure:
- Install the Sembly AI app in Attio and authorize access.
- Sign in to Sembly AI and approve the connection.
- Configure your automation rules in Attio: select which meetings to sync and what data to write into Attio.

title: Venta AI
short_description: The compliant AI colleague for sales teams in Europe

content.overview:
Venta AI is the AI-powered sales platform built for European teams. Connect your Attio workspace to automatically sync your CRM data and power intelligent prospecting workflows.

Venta AI helps sales teams find their next best customers by:

- AI Lead Research: Find qualified leads from 70+ million companies based on your ideal customer criteria
- Smart Contact Discovery: Find the perfect contact person in every company using AI—not just job title filters
- Multi-Channel Outreach: Reach prospects via personalized email, LinkedIn, and handwritten letters
- GDPR Compliance: Built in Germany with EU data protection standards at its core

Whether you're running outbound campaigns or enriching your pipeline, Venta AI brings powerful automation while keeping your Attio data in sync.
content.how_it_works:
Venta AI syncs bidirectionally with your Attio workspace:

From Attio → Venta AI:

From Venta AI → Attio:

- New contacts found by Venta AI

- Admin access to your Attio workspace

4. Configure optional custom field mappings for your workflows

After connecting, your initial sync will import existing companies and contacts. Ongoing syncs happen automatically.

title: OneCLI
short_description: AI agent gateway for secure, scoped API access to Attio

content.overview:
When your team uses AI agents (Claude, GPT, Cursor, Copilot, or custom agents), those agents often need to read contacts, update deals, create notes, or manage tasks in your CRM. OneCLI sits between the agent and Attio's API, injecting credentials on-the-fly and enforcing fine-grained permissions per agent.

With OneCLI + Attio, you can:

- Let AI agents query contacts, companies, and deals without giving them your API key

- Scope each agent to specific operations (e.g., read-only CRM access for a research agent, read-write for a sales automation agent)

- Connect multiple Attio workspaces and route requests to the right one

- Monitor every API call agents make to your Attio workspace in real time

- Revoke access instantly without rotating credentials

OneCLI handles OAuth token management, automatic token refresh, and credential encryption. Your team connects once and agents get seamless access.

title: Luo
short_description: Your work runs on Luo

content.overview:
Luo is a platform where you can use AI to do your work. It helps you complete tasks, builds you the tools you need to be more productive, and works with the tools you already use at work - email, calendars, CRM, project management, and more.
Rather than switching between applications or manually moving data between systems, you describe what you need and Luo builds it for you. Your workspace becomes a personalized operating system for your work, powered by AI.

Connect your Attio CRM to Luo and unlock powerful capabilities: build custom tools that read and update your CRM data, create tailored dashboards and reports, automate lead enrichment workflows, and orchestrate data between Attio and your other business tools like Google Workspace, Figma, Linear, and Slack.
content.how_it_works:
**Connect**: Authorize Luo to access your Attio workspace using secure OAuth authentication. 

**Build**: Use Luo's Assistant to create custom functionality and workflows. Describe what you want in natural language, and let AI help generate the logic. Access your Attio contacts, companies, deals, and custom objects directly within your builds.

**Automate**: Create workflows that interact with your CRM - automatically enrich leads, sync data across platforms, trigger actions based on deal stages, or build custom reporting dashboards. 

**Integrate**: Combine Attio data with other Luo integrations (Google Sheets, Slack, Linear, Figma) to create powerful cross-platform automations that connect your entire business stack.
content.configure:
**Requirements**: A Luo account and an Attio workspace with appropriate permissions.

**Setup**:

1. Sign up or log in to Luo at [luo.app](http://luo.app)
2. Navigate to your workspace settings and select "Integrations"
3. Click "Add Integration" and select Attio from the list
4. Authorize Luo to access your Attio workspace via OAuth
5. Configure which Attio objects (contacts, companies, deals, custom objects) you want to make available in your Luo workspace

**Permissions**: The integration requires read/write access to your Attio data depending on your feature needs. You can configure granular permissions during setup.

title: HowdyGo
short_description: Interactive product demo software for go-to-market teams

content.overview:
HowdyGo is an interactive demo platform that lets you create, share, and track product demos that capture leads and sync data to Attio. When prospects interact with your demos, their information is automatically logged in Attio as person records, with notes and custom attributes tracking their engagement.

HowdyGo helps sales and marketing teams create interactive product demonstrations that engage prospects and capture qualified leads. Instead of static videos or screenshots, HowdyGo demos let viewers interact with your product in a controlled environment, providing a hands-on experience that drives higher conversion rates.

The platform supports various demo types, including interactive walkthroughs, sandbox environments, and personalized experiences with dynamic variables. Each demo can be embedded on your website, shared via links, or included in email campaigns, making it easy to distribute your product story across multiple channels.
content.how_it_works:
Connect Attio to HowdyGo to automatically capture and sync lead data from demo interactions. When someone views your demo and submits their information, HowdyGo:

- Creates or updates person records in Attio with contact details (name, email, phone, company)
- Links people to company records when company information is provided
- Creates activity notes with markdown-formatted details about the demo viewed
- Updates custom attributes tracking the last demo viewed, including title, ID, submission URL, folder name, and form capture data

This enables real-time lead capture from your demo content, ensuring every demo interaction is logged in Attio for follow-up and analysis. The integration supports custom attributes for reporting and workflow automation, helping you identify which demos generate the most qualified leads.
content.configure:
1. Log in to your HowdyGo account
2. Navigate to Settings → Integrations
3. Select Attio from the available integrations
4. Click "Connect" to authorize the integration via OAuth
5. Grant the required permissions (read/write access to records, object configuration, and notes)
6. Once connected, HowdyGo will automatically create the necessary custom attributes in Attio and begin syncing demo interactions

The integration is now active. All future demo submissions will automatically sync to Attio, and custom attributes will be created on-demand when needed.

title: Obvious

- Add filters
- Migrate custom objects

- Auto-create custom fields

5. Continue to begin your free migration

title: Cal.com Sync
short_description: Sync events from Cal.com into Attio

Cal.com Sync is an app that automatically syncs Cal.com bookings into Attio.

It helps your team keep meetings, appointments, and scheduled customer interactions organized in one place. When someone books a meeting through Cal.com, Cal.com Sync creates a related entry in Attio and links it to the attendee’s person record when available.

This gives sales, support, and customer success teams better visibility into scheduled interactions with contacts, prospects, and customers.

### Booking updates

title: Swan
short_description: AI agent that syncs Attio records and automates GTM workflow

Swan is a GTM AI agent that helps teams automate outreach sequences, data enrichment, and CRM updates. Connect Attio to Swan to find, create, and update people, companies, and other records using information from tools such as Gong, HubSpot, Apollo, HeyReach, and Slack.

content.how_it_works:
Swan is a GTM AI agent that helps teams keep Attio accurate and automate sales workflows. Connect Attio to Swan to find, create, enrich, and update people, companies, and other records using information from tools such as Gong, HubSpot, Apollo, HeyReach, and Slack.

title: Deepline
short_description: Research and enrich Attio records with AI agents

content.overview: Deepline connects Attio to your AI coding agent and reusable Plays. Read company and contact records, research and enrich them with your chosen sources, and write results back to the right Attio attributes. Build workflows in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or Antigravity, then review each Play and its results in the Deepline dashboard.

title: Oneleet
short_description: Review who has access to your Attio workspace

content.overview:
Oneleet is a security and compliance platform. It helps companies get and stay compliant with frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

Oneleet connects to the tools a company uses and keeps a list of who has an account in each one. Security and compliance teams use that list to run access reviews and to check that people who leave the company lose their access.

The Oneleet app for Attio adds your Attio workspace to that list, so your Attio members are included whenever you review who has access to your systems.
content.how_it_works:
After you connect Attio, Oneleet regularly reads the members of your Attio workspace. For each member it stores their name, email address, avatar and access level (admin, member or suspended).

In Oneleet, each Attio member appears as an account for the Attio vendor and is linked to the matching person in your organization by email address. When you run an access review, reviewers see every Attio member and confirm whether each one still needs access.

The app only requests read access to workspace members. It doesn't read or change your records, objects, lists, notes, tasks or any other Attio data.
content.configure:
You need an Oneleet account, and an admin of the Attio workspace needs to approve the connection.

To connect Attio, open Integrations in Oneleet and choose Attio. Click Connect, and Oneleet sends you to Attio. Choose the Attio workspace you want to connect and approve the access request. Attio then sends you back to Oneleet, where the new connection appears on the Attio integration page.

Your Attio members show up in Oneleet a few minutes after the first sync. To disconnect, remove the connection from the Attio integration page in Oneleet, or uninstall the app in Attio.

title: Base44
short_description: Bring your Attio CRM data into custom Base44 apps

content.overview: Base44 is a no-code AI development platform that turns builders' ideas into fully functional apps and websites. This integration connects your Attio workspace to Base44, so you can build custom applications powered by your CRM data.
content.how_it_works:
Base44 will sync the following data from Attio:

- records: view and manage contacts, companies, and other object records

- list entries: view and manage which records belong to your lists

- notes: view notes on records

- object and list configuration: read your workspace's object and list structure to correctly map fields

- user management: view workspace members

The connection uses a secure OAuth 2.0 flow. Base44 can read and write records and list entries, so the apps you build can create and update your Attio data, not just display it. Notes, object configuration, and list configuration are read-only.
content.configure:
This integration requires the Base44 Builder plan or higher. This applies to both regular connectors and app user connectors.

To connect:

1. In Base44, open the app you want to connect to Attio.

2. Prompt the AI builder to create a connection with Attio, for example, "connect this app to my Attio account."

3. The builder will open a Connect to Attio window. Review the requested permissions.

4. Click Confirm to authorize the connection.

title: Advanced Workflow Automations
short_description: Build smarter workflows from your Attio activity

title: Flowla
short_description: Deal rooms for Attio, with auto sync and engagement tracking

content.overview:
Flowla + Attio integration links your customer-facing, collaborative deal rooms with your CRM; so all the data related to your deals, stakeholders, and buyer engagement stays synced with zero admin work.

You can then turn signals from deal rooms & Attio into smart next steps with Flowla’s no-code AI workflow builder to drive momentum in your sales & CS processes.

The result:

- 35% faster sales & onboarding,
- Clearer deal visibility for leaders,
- Less admin work and more streamlined deal management for reps,
- and a smoother buyer experience where nothing important gets lost.

title: viaSocket
short_description: Connect Attio with 2,200+ apps and automate your workflows

content.overview: Connect **Attio** with **2,200+ apps** using viaSocket to automate your sales workflows and keep your CRM in sync. Automatically create and update people, companies, deals, and tasks by connecting Attio with tools like **Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Stripe, Notion, Airtable, and thousands of other business applications,** all without writing any code.
content.how_it_works: Choose **Attio** as your trigger or action app in viaSocket, then connect it to any of **2,200+ supported applications**. You can automatically create or update Attio people, companies, deals, and tasks when events happen in other tools, or use changes in Attio to trigger actions like sending notifications, updating spreadsheets, creating tickets, or syncing customer data. Once your workflow is activated, everything runs automatically in the background.
content.configure:
1. Sign in to your **viaSocket** account or create one if you're new.
2. Go to the C**onnections** page in the left side dashboard and search for **Attio**.
3. Connect your Attio workspace by securely authenticating your account using OAuth or your Attio API token (depending on the authentication method).
4. Choose **Attio** as your **trigger** or **action** app, then connect it with any of **2,200+ supported applications** such as Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Notion, or Stripe.
5. Configure your workflow by selecting the Attio event you want to automate, map the required fields, and activate your automation.

Once enabled, viaSocket automatically keeps your Attio records and connected apps synchronized, with **no coding required**.

title: Quotient
short_description: Automate your marketing using Attio People and Company data

content.how_it_works:
Quotient can sync the following data from Attio, real-time and two-way (*as desired, you can choose which objects to sync, the direction of the sync, and which fields to sync*):

- Full people records - name, email, associated company, job title, relationship owner, location, social media profiles, lead scores, notes, and all custom Attio fields (e.g., custom user IDs). Direct Attio links are embedded in all People objects imported from Attio for easy navigation between platforms for a given record.
    - People created in Quotient sync back to Attio real-time.
- Full company records - name, activity, associated deals, description, domain, industry, location, employees, estimated revenue, owner, notes, and all custom Attio fields (e.g., Pricing Plan name).

Within the tool, these fields can be utilized in order to run account-based marketing campaigns for specific industry / size / revenue companies, create segments of people for interest-based marketing campaigns, and more.

title: Sim
short_description: Build, deploy, and manage AI Agents

content.overview: Build, deploy, and orchestrate AI agents. Sim is the open source central intelligence layer for your AI workforce. Connect Sim to Attio to automate your CRM workflows — manage records, notes, tasks, lists, comments, and webhooks with 40 tools and 18 real-time webhook triggers.
content.how_it_works: Sim connects to your Attio workspace via OAuth to manage your CRM data through automated workflows. You can create, read, update, and delete records, notes, tasks, lists, list entries, comments, and webhooks. Sim also supports 18 webhook triggers so your workflows can react in real time to events like new records, updated tasks, or resolved comments. Use the Attio block in the workflow editor to select an operation, connect your Attio account, and configure the parameters — or let the AI agent fill them in dynamically.
content.configure: Connect your Attio account by clicking the OAuth credential selector in the Attio block. Sim will request access to your Attio workspace. No API keys needed — authentication is handled entirely through OAuth. Once connected, select an operation from the dropdown (e.g. Create Record, Search Records, Create Task) and fill in the required fields. For webhook triggers, add the Attio trigger to your workflow and configure the event type you want to listen for. Sim will automatically register the webhook with Attio.

title: RevenueHero
short_description: Inbound lead conversion & scheduling

title: Foyai
short_description: Turn Attio deals into powerful sales rooms

content.configure:
**1. Create your Foyai workspace.**

**2. Connect Attio.** Connect your Attio workspace through Attio's secure OAuth login. Foyai never sees or stores your password, access is scoped to the one workspace you connect, and you can disconnect anytime, which immediately stops all syncing.

**3. Bring in your content.** Paste your website and Foyai scans it to pull your case studies in automatically. Connect Google Drive to easily add content so you have the right content from day one.

**4. Create your first room.** Pick a company or deal, choose a call, and let Foyai draft the room from your transcripts.

**What the connection allows:**

- Foyai **reads** your call transcripts, companies, and deals to draft rooms
- Foyai **writes** engagement notes and action-plan tasks back to the linked records
- No Attio data is ever shown to buyers. Rooms only ever display the content you've reviewed and published

title: Konnectify
short_description: Connect Attio to your other apps and automate workflows

content.overview:
Connect Attio to Konnectify to automate workflows and integrate Attio with hundreds of business applications. Trigger automated processes when changes happen in Attio, such as new contacts, updated records, or deal changes. Konnectify can then perform actions in other tools your teams use every day.

You can also sync data from external services back into your Attio workspace, keeping customer information consistent across sales, marketing, support, and operations platforms. This helps reduce manual updates and keeps every team working with accurate, up-to-date data.

Once connected, Konnectify runs your workflows automatically in the background, moving data between Attio and your other tools whenever events occur.
content.how_it_works:
Start by connecting your Attio account to Konnectify along with the other apps you use. Then create a workflow by choosing a trigger and defining the actions that should follow. For example, when a new person is created in Attio, Konnectify can automatically add the person to a marketing platform, create a task in a project management tool, or send a notification to your team.

Once the workflow is activated, Konnectify runs it automatically in the background, continuously syncing data and executing actions whenever the trigger conditions are met.

title: Partnero
short_description: Keep affiliates, deals, and commissions in sync

content.overview:
The Partnero and Attio integration automatically keeps your partner program and CRM in sync. Partners, customers, and transactions are shared between both platforms in real time, so your data stays consistent without manual updates.

The integration works in both directions. Records created or updated in Partnero are pushed to Attio. Actions taken in Attio, like closing a deal, create transactions and trigger partner commissions in Partnero. Each program connects to Attio separately using OAuth 2.0.
content.configure:
**Requirements**

- A Partnero paid subscription (the integration can be set up and tested on a free trial, but a subscription is required for ongoing use)
- An Attio account with permission to install integrations

**Setup**

1. In Partnero, open the program you want to connect and go to **Integrations → Attio**.
2. Click **Connect with Attio** and complete the OAuth authorization. You'll be redirected to Attio to grant access, then automatically returned to Partnero.
3. Use the field mapping tabs to configure what syncs for Partners, Customers, and Deals.
4. Set the Attio deal stage that should trigger a "deal won" event in Partnero.
5. Save your settings. Sync begins immediately for new and updated records.

title: Workflow Chain
short_description: Trigger Attio workflows from other workflows

content.overview:
Workflow Chain adds native workflow chaining to Attio. Use one workflow to start another, pass a record or payload, and keep the complete source run context attached to every handoff.

Replace checkbox workarounds and external automation tools with two blocks that live inside the Attio workflow editor. Workflow Chain is designed for reusable enrichment, qualification, routing and operational subflows.

The app runs entirely on Attio hosted App SDK capabilities. It requires no API key, OAuth connection or external service account.
content.how_it_works:
Add Workflow invoked as the trigger on the target workflow and assign a unique channel.

Add Trigger workflow to the source workflow, enter the same channel, then optionally map an Attio record and a text or JSON payload.

When the source step runs, Workflow Chain looks up the registered target and sends the invocation through the callback provided by Attio. The target receives the payload, record reference, source workflow identifier, source run identifier, titles and direct URLs as native outputs.

Each call includes a unique idempotency key. Temporary rate limits and server errors are treated as retryable failures.
content.configure:
No external configuration is required after installation.

For each target workflow, choose a unique channel in the Workflow invoked trigger and publish the workflow. Then use that exact channel in every Trigger workflow step that should call it. Channel names are trimmed and normalized to lower case. One active target can own a channel inside a workspace.

The record and payload fields are optional. Workflow automation credit usage remains governed by the workspace Attio plan.

Full setup instructions, output definitions, behavior notes, support and privacy information are available in the Buildrhaus documentation.

title: Probo Access Review
short_description: Bring Attio workspace members into your access reviews

content.how_it_works:
Probo Access Review reads a single endpoint, GET /v2/workspace\_members, using the user\_management:read scope. For each workspace member it collects the first and last name, the email address, the access level, the workspace member ID, and the date the member was created. It writes nothing back to Attio.

Attio does not delete workspace members, so a member who loses access keeps their record with the access level set to suspended. Probo reports those seats as inactive rather than dropping them, which is what an auditor needs to see. Attio exposes no last sign-in and no multi-factor status, so Probo leaves those fields blank rather than guessing at them.
content.configure: You need a Probo organization and an Attio workspace administrator to authorize the connection. In Probo, go to Access Review, then Connections, find Attio and choose OAuth. Attio asks you to approve read access to user management, and the source then appears in your campaigns as Attio followed by your workspace name. A workspace access token created under Settings, Developers, Access tokens with User Management set to Read works as an alternative to OAuth.

title: AutoScaled
short_description: Generate personalized sales presentations from Attio data

content.configure:
To get started with the Attio integration:

- **Plan requirement:** The Attio integration requires an AutoScaled Plus plan or higher. Upgrade at [autoscaled.com/pricing](http://autoscaled.com/pricing)
- **Connect Attio:** Link your Attio workspace from the Data Sources page inside AutoScaled. Setup takes under a minute and no technical knowledge is required.
- **Walkthrough video:** Learn how to use Attio data from company, people and custom records in 3 minutes. Watch the walkthrough: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qU7J4sk0o0U](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qU7J4sk0o0U)

title: Cotera Pre Meeting Research
short_description: Get a dossier on the person you're meeting with.

content.overview:
**Cotera’s Pre-Meeting Agent** instantly delivers deep, actionable research on any company and prospect - so you attend every meeting fully prepared.

Get comprehensive company insights including hiring trends, recent news, acquisitions, funding rounds, executive changes, context from past calls, open deals, and notes from Attio. Then, seamlessly layer in prospect-level intelligence: LinkedIn activity, work history, recent posts and comments, role context, location, and bio.

The Pre-Meeting Agent synthesizes everything into a polished briefing built for winning meetings. It highlights **Why Now**, **Why Us**, **Why Change**, tailored discovery questions, and personalized angles - giving you the clarity and confidence to lead every conversation with impact.
content.configure: You can find the Cotera app on the Integrations and apps page in your Attio account. You will then install the Cotera app. Please sign up for a Cotera account (you get $5 for free) at [app.cotera.co](http://app.cotera.co). Use your billing ID from settings/organization and enter it in your app settings in Attio.

title: fastn.ai
short_description: Unified API to embed and manage SaaS integrations.

content.overview:
[Fastn.ai](http://Fastn.ai) is a unified integration platform that enables SaaS products to connect securely with hundreds of third-party applications through a single API. Instead of building and maintaining multiple custom connectors, teams use Fastn to authenticate, orchestrate, and monitor integrations from one place.

With Fastn, developers can:

- Add integrations with email, meetings, CRMs, and project tools in minutes.
- Manage authentication, token refresh, and error handling automatically.
- Use the dashboard to monitor workspace activity, latency, and API call metrics.
- Support AI-powered workflows that trigger or combine multiple app actions.

Fastn eliminates repetitive backend work and accelerates go-to-market for integration-driven products.
content.how_it_works:
1. **Authenticate** — Connect any supported app using OAuth 2.0 via Fastn’s unified authorization flow.
2. **Configure** — Select prebuilt connectors or define custom actions through Fastn’s command layer.
3. **Integrate** — Use a single API to read, write, and automate across multiple apps.
4. **Monitor** — Track integration performance, API usage, and errors in real time from the dashboard.

Fastn’s Unified Command Layer (UCL) enables developers and AI agents to perform tasks through natural-language or API-level commands, such as scheduling meetings, sending emails, or syncing customer data across platforms.
content.configure:
1. Sign in to your Fastn workspace.
2. Navigate to **C**onnectors and select **Attio**.
3. Click **Connect** to securely authenticate your Attio account.
4. Configure your workspace to enable actions such as deal and company syncing, record updates, and activity tracking.
5. Test the connection and deploy.

Fastn automatically manages OAuth tokens, permission scopes, and data isolation, ensuring a secure, multitenant integration for all connected users.

title: Ventos

Ventos is an AI operating layer for VC and investment firms. The Attio integration brings CRM data and workflows into Ventos, allowing teams to search and analyze their records in context, then create and update the CRM.

With the Attio integration, your CRM becomes the foundation of your firm's institutional memory. Ventos indexes your contacts, companies, deal notes, and pipeline stages, then makes all of it queryable in plain language - from Slack, WhatsApp, or email, without opening a tab.
content.how_it_works:
Ventos connects Attio to your organisation's AI workspace. It indexes Attio records and notes so your team can search CRM data, ask questions, and get context-aware answers in Ventos.

Ventos also takes actions in Attio on behalf of the user. Users can create and update records, create and update notes, manage tasks and list entries, and upload files to Attio records.
content.configure:

5. Allow the initial sync to complete (typically a few minutes depending on CRM size)

title: Docusign Workflows by Fluidlabs
short_description: Pre-fill Docusign agreements and file them back in Attio

content.overview:
Docusign Workflows by Fluidlabs connects Attio to Docusign Workflow Builder - the workflow builder in Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM). Your agreement workflows can read Attio records to pre-fill documents, update records when an agreement is signed, and file the signed PDF on the record it belongs to.

## Why teams use it

- Send order forms, offer letters and contracts pre-filled with up-to-date Attio data instead of copying names, emails and amounts by hand
- Keep your pipeline current by moving a deal to a new stage or updating a value the moment the agreement is completed
- Keep every signed agreement next to the record it belongs to, in the record's files

## Works with your workspace

The app loads the objects and attributes in your workspace when you connect, so it works with people, companies, deals, your custom objects and your custom attributes.

Docusign Workflows integration is built and supported by Fluidlabs.

title: Integrately
short_description: Integrately - No code automation platform

content.overview: Integrately is an integration platform that serves as a bridge, enabling users to connect and automate workflows between different apps and services effortlessly. It allows users to create "integrations'' or "scenarios" that automate actions and data transfer between different apps and services without requiring major knowledge of coding. Users can determine what data they want to transfer from the source app to the destination app. Our main aim is to offer users simple, ready-made automation options that they can activate with just one click.
content.how_it_works:
Integrately is an automation platform that allows users to connect multiple web applications and services to create automated workflows. It allows users to create "integrations" or "scenarios" that automate actions and data transfer between multiple apps and services without requiring major knowledge of coding.

Users can set up triggers and actions to create complicated automation sequences, and Integrately supports a wide range of popular apps and services, including social media networks, email services, cloud storage, project management tools, and more. 

Please see the YouTube video for more information: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dNC0eENIbH4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dNC0eENIbH4)

title: Superjoin Connector
short_description: AI-Powered data sync between Attio and Google Sheets

content.how_it_works:
Superjoin connects your Attio workspace directly to your spreadsheet, so your team can work with live CRM data where they already are.

1. **Connect:** Install Superjoin and authorize your Attio workspace in a couple of clicks. No code or technical setup required.
2. **Pull your data in:** Import any Attio object, including companies, people, deals, or custom objects, into Google Sheets. Pick the attributes you need and filter to just the records that matter.
3. **Keep it fresh:** Refresh data on a schedule you choose, so your reports and models always reflect the latest state of your workspace.
4. **Build on top:** Use familiar spreadsheet formulas, pivots, and dashboards to report, forecast, and collaborate on your data, with no exports required.
content.configure:
1. **Install Superjoin:** Open Google Sheets, go to Extensions > Add-ons > Get add-ons, search for Superjoin, and install it. Open it from Extensions > Superjoin > Open.
2. **Sign in to Superjoin:** In the sidebar, sign in with your Google account or your Superjoin workspace.
3. **Connect your Attio account:** Click Add a connection, then Attio, and authorize Superjoin to access your Attio workspace using OAuth. You will be redirected to Attio to approve, then back to the sheet.
4. **Choose what to import:** Select the Attio object you want, such as companies, people, deals, or any custom object. Pick the attributes you need and apply filters so you only pull the records you want.
5. **Import into your sheet:** Click Import. Superjoin writes the live data into your sheet, ready to use with formulas, pivots, and charts.
6. **Set a refresh schedule:** Turn on auto-refresh, hourly or daily, so the data stays in sync with Attio automatically, or refresh manually anytime.

title: Airstride
short_description: Partner revenue growth platform for channel teams

title: Firestarter
short_description: An AI commercial team that does the work, not the talk

content.overview:
Firestarter gives a small business an AI commercial team — named colleagues who do the marketing and sales work, not a chatbot that describes it.

Connect Attio and your team can read and act on your CRM directly. Vera, who runs sales, pulls the companies and people you actually have, checks where every deal sits in the pipeline, and writes the follow-up back into Attio — a note on the record, a task for the right workspace member, a deal moved to the next stage.

Nothing is written to your workspace without you approving that exact change first. You see the record, the fields and the values before anything happens.
content.configure:
