title: Targenix
short_description: Send Facebook and Instagram lead ads to Attio instantly

content.overview:
Targenix sends your Facebook and Instagram lead ads to Attio the moment someone submits your form. Each new lead becomes a person in Attio, and can open a deal in your pipeline, so your team follows up in seconds instead of downloading CSV files from Meta.

### Who it is for

Sales teams, agencies and founders who run lead generation campaigns on Facebook and Instagram and manage their pipeline in Attio.

### Highlights

- Real-time delivery of every new lead from Facebook and Instagram lead forms
- People are matched by email address, so a returning lead updates the same record instead of creating a duplicate
- Optional deal for each lead, with the stage, owner and value you choose
- Every form question and answer saved as a note on the person
- Extra form questions mapped to your own text and number attributes
- Automatic retries and a delivery log for every lead in Targenix

title: Chirp
short_description: Update Attio by voice after every sales call

content.overview:
Chirp is a voice assistant for salespeople. After a meeting or call, open the Chirp app and talk to Birdie, our assistant, the way you would brief a colleague. Birdie works out which deals, people and companies you mean, and turns what you said into Attio updates: a new deal stage, updated details, and notes from the conversation.

Reps spend hours a week typing up CRM notes, and most of it happens late or never. With Chirp, the update takes a minute on the walk back to the car, and your Attio workspace stays current without anyone chasing it.

You can also ask Birdie about your pipeline before a meeting, such as where a deal is up to or when you last spoke to someone, and hear the answer straight from your Attio data.
content.how_it_works:
Chirp will sync the following data from Attio: companies, people, deals and their stages, notes, tasks, meetings, and workspace members, so updates are made under the right owner.

First, connect your Attio workspace from the Chirp app. Chirp imports your records so Birdie can recognise the names you say.

After a conversation, tap to talk and describe what happened. Birdie confirms the records it matched and the changes it heard.

Then review the changes in the app and send them to Attio. Chirp writes the updated fields and notes to the matching records, and keeps them in sync as your team edits in Attio.

Your voice is transcribed and processed by AI to understand your update. Chirp only changes Attio records after you review them, and you can disconnect Attio at any time from the Chirp app.
content.configure:
You will need a Chirp account and the Chirp app for iPhone, available on the App Store. In the app, go to Connectors, choose Attio and sign in to approve access for your workspace. The first import starts straight away and usually finishes within a few minutes, depending on the size of your workspace.

Chirp uses Attio’s standard deal object and its stage attribute, so no custom setup is needed. Each rep connects their own account, and updates are attributed to the workspace member who approved the connection.

title: Dimedove
short_description: Qualify leads at scale.

content.how_it_works:
Once connected, Dimedove agents can interact with your Attio workspace to create and update CRM records based on information collected during conversations.

Typical actions include creating new people or company records, updating existing contacts with additional details, and attaching structured qualification data captured by the agent. This can include information such as contact details, company information, intent signals, or responses gathered during the conversation.

When a visitor engages with a Dimedove agent, the agent can determine whether a new record should be created in Attio or whether an existing record should be updated. The information collected during the interaction is then written directly to the appropriate fields inside your CRM.

This allows conversational insights to flow automatically into Attio so your team always has access to the most up to date information without manual entry.
content.configure:
To use this integration, you will need an active Dimedove account and subscription.

Once your workspace is set up, open the Settings section in Dimedove and navigate to the Integrations page. From there, locate the Attio integration and click Configure.

You will be guided through a secure authentication flow to connect your Attio workspace and authorize Dimedove to interact with your CRM data.

After the connection is completed, the integration will appear as active in your integrations settings. You can then configure your Dimedove agents to create or update Attio records automatically as they qualify and collect information from prospects.

title: Qobra
short_description: #1 AI sales compensation and commission management platform

content.overview:
Qobra is a sales compensation platform that automates commission calculations and gives revenue teams real-time visibility on their earnings. Finance and RevOps teams design commission plans without code; sales reps track their commissions live instead of waiting for end-of-quarter spreadsheets.

With the Attio integration, your Attio workspace becomes the source of truth for compensation. Qobra imports your objects and lists — deals, companies, pipeline stages, custom attributes — and matches records to their owners, so commissions are always calculated on up-to-date CRM data and attributed to the right rep. No CSV exports, no manual reconciliation.

title: Veck
short_description: Send Veck projects to Attio as deals

content.overview:
Send Veck projects to Attio as deals in one click. A project card becomes a deal in your Attio pipeline with fields filled in: deal name, stage (set in Connectors), owner, related company, and people.

**What gets created:**

- A deal with the chosen stage
- A related company (project data)
- Related people (from the card, in your Attio people pipeline)
- Deal owner
- Dates and description

Sync is one-way: after creation, manage the deal in Attio. Connect via OAuth 2.0 in about 30 seconds.

Profile → Connectors → Connect Attio → Choose list (and optional people/company lists)

- Deal name (from project name)
- Deal stage (from Veck Connectors settings)
- Deal owner (from Veck Connectors settings)
- Associated company (project data)
- Associated people (from the card, in your Attio people list)
- Dates and description

Deal is created in Attio. One-way sync: manage the deal in Attio; no sync back to Veck.
content.configure:
#### Requirements

- Veck and Attio accounts (any plan)

#### Setup

1. Go to Profile → Connectors → Connect Attio
2. Select your Attio deal list (and optionally people/company lists)
3. Set default deal stage and deal owner

On any project card, click "Send to Attio" — a deal will be created with your Connectors settings.

- Dates, description

One-way send only.

title: Wring
short_description: Claim AWS new client credits when you win a deal

Wring Funding turns your won deals into AWS funding.

The application is pre-filled from your deal (client name, value, close date), so there's nothing to fill in manually. 

Built by Wring (wring.co), AWS funding and cost-optimization experts.
content.how_it_works:

Click Claim. Wring instantly pre-fills your F3 (New Client Credits) application from the deal data.

Review the pre-filled application in your Wring dashboard and submit — Wring handles the rest with AWS.
content.configure:

2. Accept the workspace connection to Wring (Connections tab → Connect) — one click, OAuth. No API keys to manage; Wring Funding communicates securely with Wring on your behalf.

title: AgentTeams
short_description: AI employees that keep your CRM up to date

content.overview:
AgentTeams gives your team AI employees: coworkers with a name, a role and their own seat in the tools you already use. Connect Attio and an employee works in your workspace like any teammate. It keeps records current, moves deals through your pipeline, turns recorded calls into notes and follow-up tasks, and picks up the tasks and comments you send its way.

Every employee follows your team's playbook. Changes go through a review step, and your rules decide which ones need a person to approve them.
content.configure:
1. Sign up for AgentTeams and hire an AI employee, or open one you already have.
2. On the employee's Tools tab, choose Attio and select Sign in with Attio. If you started from the Attio App Store, sign in to AgentTeams and pick the employee instead.

4. When asked who the employee is in Attio, pick its own member seat, or another member it should work as. Tasks assigned to that member and comments that mention them go to the employee.

title: Bound
short_description: Bound is your FX copilot

content.overview: We make FX hedging simple, flexible and easy to understand. Our platform does the heavy lifting, and our FX specialists are here when you need them — so you can manage currency risk with confidence.
content.how_it_works: Connect your Attio workspace to Bound. We turn your CRM into clear FX projections, so you can see upcoming currency exposure and plan your hedging early.

title: Helios
short_description: The AI-native workflow automation platform

title: Regional Task Queue
short_description: Process your task queue by region and type

content.overview:
Regional Task Queue turns up to the first 1,999 incomplete Attio tasks assigned to the current member into a focused queue for regional execution. It groups the loaded tasks into AUS, Europe, US and Other, then groups each region by task type and sorts tasks by deadline, with undated work last.

Everything stays inside Attio. Open the queue from companies or people, review one slice at a time and mark each task complete as you work. No external account, workspace setting or service connection is required.
content.configure:
No external account, API key, service connection or workspace setting is required. After an Attio admin installs the app and approves its permissions, members can open companies or people and launch Regional task queue from Show menu.

User Management read access identifies the active workspace member. Records read access retrieves the names and primary locations of linked people and companies. Object Configuration read access resolves linked object identifiers. Tasks read and write access lists the active member’s incomplete tasks, verifies the selected task and marks that task complete. The app does not create, delete or edit people or company records.

For clear type groups, begin a task title with a square bracket label such as [CALL], [EMAIL] or [FOLLOW-UP]. Any task without a leading label remains available under UNCATEGORIZED. Region groups use the primary location on linked people or companies. The app performs no scheduled processing and makes no background writes.

title: Tinct
short_description: Personalize your landing pages for every company you target

content.overview:
You're spending thousands on LinkedIn Ads to reach the right person at the right company — then sending every click to the same generic page. 

Tinct fixes that. It generates a personalized version of your page for each company on your target list automatically. 

Their industry. Their pain points. Use cases they recognize. Social proof from companies like theirs.
content.how_it_works:
Add a list of target companies from you CRM, or upload it. 

Tinct's AI researches each one — industry, pain points, use case — and generates a unique landing page per account. Visitors are automatically detected and routed to their page. No code. Live in minutes. Try it for free.
content.configure:

title: Caddie AI

title: CoreSpeed
short_description: Connect Attio to secure AI agents and workflows

content.overview: CoreSpeed connects AI agents and automated workflows to your Attio workspace through an OAuth connector. Agents use the MCP interface hosted by CoreSpeed; CoreSpeed then calls Attio's REST API with the workspace permissions you authorize. This app does not register an MCP server with Attio or add an MCP endpoint to Ask Attio. Use the connector to discover CRM objects and lists, look up workspace members, find records, and create or update records in existing objects.

title: Stimulir
short_description: Agent Business OS

content.overview: Stimulir connects Attio with AI workflows for business operations. It helps teams monitor pipeline activity, surface risks, generate insights, and coordinate follow-up work across customer and revenue operations.
content.how_it_works: A workspace admin connects Attio to Stimulir once for the whole workspace. Stimulir then reads the approved Attio data needed to power dashboards, trends, workflows, and operator actions inside Stimulir.
content.configure: An admin must connect the Attio workspace from Stimulir Business Profile > Integrations. Access inside Stimulir is controlled by business-level permissions and feature flags.

title: Pollen
short_description: AI agents for customer success

content.overview: Pollen is an AI agent for customer success that helps founders and small teams manage their entire customer base without hiring CSMs. It connects to your CRM, email, support tickets, product usage data, and news to autonomously monitor every customer relationship — detecting churn risks, surfacing upsell signals, and taking action before things slip through the cracks. Pollen integrates with Attio to keep your customer data in sync, so your AI agent always has the full context it needs to act on your behalf. Whether you're managing 20 customers or 200, Pollen gives you the coverage of a full CS team at a fraction of the cost.
content.how_it_works:
Pollen will sync the following data from Attio to power your AI customer success agent:

- **Companies & Contacts** — Pollen reads your Attio workspace to build a complete map of your customer accounts, key stakeholders, and relationship history.
- **Deal & Account Stages** — Pollen monitors stage changes and account health signals to detect when customers are at risk or ready to expand.
- **Notes & Activity** — Historical interactions logged in Attio are used to give Pollen context on each relationship, so it can take informed, personalized action.
- **Custom Attributes** — Any custom fields you've configured in Attio (ARR, tier, renewal date, health score) are pulled in to enrich Pollen's understanding of each account.
content.configure: You will need to be on the Pollen Pro plan to use this app. Once connected, authorize Pollen to access your Attio workspace using OAuth. Pollen will request read and write access to your Companies, People, Deals, Notes, and custom object types. No manual field mapping is required — Pollen automatically detects your workspace schema on first sync. Initial sync typically completes within a few minutes. You can configure which workspaces and object types Pollen has access to from your Pollen dashboard under Settings → Integrations → Attio.

title: Stilla
short_description: Let AI closes the loop: customer request → ship → close deal

content.overview: Connect Stilla to Attio to close the loop between customer conversations, product development, and revenue. Stilla goes beyond note-taking — it captures meetings, detects customer needs, drives product work, and keeps your CRM up to date at every step. Build AI automations using natural language — no code required.
content.configure:
**Connect Attio to Stilla with a single click inside the Stilla app** — you're up and running in seconds. Stilla will automatically match meeting participants to the right Attio records.

As you grow, add AI automations to route customer feedback to your product tools and keep deal records updated as work progresses. Your team only needs to set this up once — Stilla handles the rest.

title: Sequence
short_description: Modern quotes, contracts and billing for AI and SaaS

content.overview:
By connecting your CRM data directly with Sequence's powerful quoting and invoicing engine, you can automate the entire quote-to-cash process without manual data entry or system switching.

Empower your teams with a unified workflow that maintains data integrity across systems and accelerates your revenue operations. Sales teams can generate quotes with accurate customer data, while finance teams gain visibility into the sales pipeline for more predictable revenue forecasting.

Sequence's quoting, billing and revenue recognition platform is purpose-built for B2B SaaS companies with complex pricing models, including usage-based, seat-based, and hybrid approaches.
content.how_it_works:
When a deal progresses in Attio, sales teams can instantly create customers in Sequence using accurate company data. With a single click, they can launch Sequence's quote builder directly from the Attio deal, maintaining context throughout the process.

The integration provides contextual backlinks between systems, so team members can navigate seamlessly between platforms.

For finance teams, the integration ensures customer data remains consistent across systems, reducing errors and speeding up the billing process. Once a quote is signed, Sequence automatically generates accurate invoices based on contract terms defined during the sales process.

title: Measure
short_description: Spin up contracts and automate billing for your contacts

content.overview:
Integrate Attio with Measure to streamline your sales workflows with automated contract management. Simplify your revenue operations by keeping your sales motion in one place.

Empower your team with real-time sales pipeline, pricing, and renewal updates to upsell effectively.

Integrating Measure with Attio makes it easy to spin up and manage contracts for your contacts in Attio.
content.configure:
To get started with the Attio integration, select **Integrations > Available Apps > Attio**.

This will take you to an OAuth confirmation screen to grant Measure access to your Attio workspace.

Once you’ve connected Attio, Measure allows you to search your contacts in Attio while creating contracts or subscriptions. This reduces the effort to spin up contracts for your customers to make deals and invoicing move faster.

Measure will allow for Action Mapping and Field Mapping with Attio for a highly customized integration. The Action Mapping determines what happens in Attio when actions happen in Maple and vice versa. You can configure either Maple or Attio to be the source of truth on the customer or contract information.

This is particularly useful for when you want deal stages to update in Attio based on the status of contract signatures in Measure.

title: Hyperline
short_description: The new standard for revenue management

content.overview:
Hyperline is an end-to-end platform for revenue management. From contracts to cash in the bank, it centralizes every step of your revenue process in one unified system. Negotiate deals, automate invoicing, manage subscriptions and usage-based billing, collect payments, and reconcile revenue faster — all with full visibility from start to finish.

The Hyperline Attio app enables you to create custom quotes or manage subscriptions directly from your Attio deals or companies using pre-built actions. It equips your teams with billing context and allows you to build advanced workflows or analyses in Attio based on your billing data.

Additionally, the integration can automatically sync your Hyperline quotes, subscriptions, and invoices into Attio as custom objects.
content.how_it_works:
The Hyperline Attio app provides:

- **Record actions** to manage customers, create quotes, and create subscriptions.
- **Embedded Hyperline UIs and capabilities** directly within Attio, allowing sales reps to stay in the CRM while accessing the full Hyperline CPQ experience.
- **Pre-built widgets** that give an overview of a company’s quotes and subscriptions.
- **Automated data sync** between Hyperline and Attio for:
    - customers
    - quotes, their line items, and phases
    - subscriptions, their products, coupons, and phases
    - invoices and invoice line-item details
    - custom properties
content.configure:
1. Go to the **Integrations** page in your Hyperline settings.
2. Click the **Connect** button under the **Attio** card.
3. A new page will open to authorize Attio. Log in to your Attio account and click **Accept**.
4. You will be redirected to the Hyperline integrations page, where Attio will appear as **Setup in progress**. After a few minutes, the integration will switch to **Connected** and be ready to use.
5. In Attio, navigate to **Workspace settings > Apps > Hyperline > Workspace Connection > Connect**, and enter an API key generated in your Hyperline settings, in order to use to use the widgets and record actions.

title: MonetizeNow
short_description: AI-powered CPQ, Billing, Metering for omni-channel B2B SaaS

content.overview:
MonetizeNow is an AI-powered Unified Quote-to-Revenue platform built to transform how B2B SaaS companies manage revenue. 

Unlike fragmented solutions that force companies to duct-tape CPQ, Billing, Metering, and Revenue Recognition, MonetizeNow unifies them in a single architecture powered by one product catalog and one contract schema. 

The result: faster sales cycles, simpler finance operations, and scalability without the heavy services burden of legacy tools.
content.how_it_works:
We’ve built a **bi-directional connector with Attio** — enabling seamless data flow across both systems.

- **From Attio → MonetizeNow:** Companies, People, and Deals sync effortlessly.


- **From MonetizeNow → Attio:** Quotes and Contracts flow back, keeping the CRM always up to date.

What makes this integration unique is that MonetizeNow’s data model is **centered around the Contract object** — the true source of truth for revenue. This architecture makes complex workflows like **amendments (cross-sells, upsells, downsells), renewals, proration, co-terming, and contract expansion** simple and automated.
content.configure: For step by step instructions on how to connect Attio and MonetizeNow, please refer to our [documentation](https://docs.monetizenow.io/docs/attio-configuration-guide).

title: Turnstile
short_description: Complete quote-to-cash for sales led startups in minutes

content.how_it_works: Turnstile integrates seamlessly to Attio to sync your customer and prospect data, ensuring your quotes and invoices always contain accurate customer data, saving you time and reducing errors.

short_description: Create and sync QuickBooks invoices from any Attio record

content.how_it_works:
1. Install AttiBooks from the Attio Marketplace.
2. Connect your QuickBooks Online account from the settings page. AttiBooks handles OAuth tokens and refreshes them automatically.
3. Open any record in Attio and click "Create QuickBooks Invoice" from the record actions menu.

title: Solvimon
short_description: Integration for Solvimon quote to cash solution

content.overview:
Solvimon connects your CRM to billing infrastructure built for hybrid pricing. By syncing customer, subscription, and usage data between Attio and Solvimon, your sales team gains real-time visibility into what customers are actually using.

For companies running hybrid models (seats + usage + credits), the disconnect between CRM and billing creates blind spots. Sales reps quote customers who are already spending through PLG. Finance reconciles spreadsheets instead of closing books. Revenue leaks through the cracks between systems.

Your Attio instance becomes a single view of customer spend across self-serve and sales-led motions, and without custom orchestration code.

Built by the team that scaled Adyen's billing engine, Solvimon handles the complexity of modern monetization: multi-entity invoicing, credit burndown, usage based pricing, and enterprise contracts with commits.
content.how_it_works:
The Solvimon Attio app provides:

1. **Bi-directional customer sync.** Create a customer in Attio, and they appear in Solvimon. Update billing details in Solvimon, and they reflect in your CRM. No manual data entry, no drift between systems.
2. **Usage and subscription visibility.** See real-time subscription status, usage metrics, and credit balances directly on company records in Attio. Sales reps know exactly where customers stand before every conversation
3. **PLG + SLG unified view.** Self-serve signups and enterprise contracts appear in the same customer record. When a free user hits usage limits, sales sees the signal immediately.
4. **Automated data sync** between Solvimon and Attio for:

- Customers and contacts
- Subscriptions and their pricing tiers
- Usage events and credit balances
- Invoices and payment status
- Custom billing attributes

5. **Embedded actions.** Generate quotes, adjust subscriptions, or provision entitlements directly from Attio deal records using Solvimon's pre-built actions.
content.configure:
In Attio, navigate to **Workspace settings > Apps**.

Find and install the **Solvimon** app.

In your Solvimon dashboard, go to **Settings-> API Keys**

1. Click **Add API Key,** call it "Attio token" and copy the token
2. Return to Attio and paste the API key into the Solvimon app connection settings
3. Select your instance
4. Test the connection
5. Begin the sync process

Once connected, Solvimon data will begin syncing to Attio within minutes.

For advanced configuration—including custom field mapping, webhook triggers, and multi-entity setups refer to the [Solvimon documentation](https://docs.solvimon.com/docs/crm) or contact your account team.

title: Zoom
short_description: Record, transcribe and analyze your Zoom calls in Attio

title: Granola

title: Fireflies.ai

title: Circleback
short_description: AI-powered meeting notes and automations.

content.overview: Connect Attio with Circleback to automatically save call summaries as notes and organize your post-meeting work. Now you can action items as tasks, keep your teams up-to-date, and gain more insights from your meetings.
content.how_it_works: Once you’ve set up a workflow with Attio, Circleback will look up the people you met with after meetings, using the emails invited to the calendar event. For each person found in Attio, a note will be automatically added with the selected meeting outcomes.

title: Allo
short_description: Get phone numbers with unlimited calls, synced to Attio

content.overview: Connect Allô with Attio to give your team a complete view of customer interactions. Say goodbye to the hassle of manually logging calls or messages—Allô takes care of it for you. Your team can focus on building relationships and growing the business, not on tedious data entry.
