3. Click **Connect to Attio** to start the integration process.
4. You’ll be redirected to Attio where you can log in to your workspace.
5. Authorize Spinach AI by clicking **Grant Access**.

You can find more documentation on Spinach AI’s integration with Attio [**here**](https://help.spinach.ai/en/articles/10002825-attio-integration).

title: MeetGeek
short_description: Automatically send meeting notes and tasks to Attio

content.overview: Integrate Attio with MeetGeek to seamlessly push meeting summaries, key highlights and tasks into Attio. Send updates manually or automate everything with custom workflows.
content.how_it_works:
**Supercharge your meetings with automated intelligence**

MeetGeek turns every conversation into valuable, searchable knowledge - without you lifting a finger. It plugs into your calendar, joins your calls across all major video conference platforms, and delivers crystal-clear transcriptions.

**Sell smarter with effortless CRM updates**

MeetGeek automatically pushes every meeting info to the right people and companies in Attio. No missed notes. No manual data entry. Just a cleaner, more powerful pipeline.

**Seamless integration for unstoppable workflows**

With an integration-first design, MeetGeek ensures your notes, transcripts, and action items flow directly into Attio, keeping your team aligned and accelerating every stage of your sales motion.
content.configure:
MeetGeek ensures your notes reach the right people in Attio by matching participants by email. 

You can choose to attach notes to the relevant companies, automatically create tasks from Next Steps highlights, and even create new Attio person records for participants who don’t yet exist in your workspace.

title: Amie
short_description: Record meetings and sync AI summaries

content.overview: Connect Amie with Attio to ensure your CRM includes all meeting summaries automatically. We sync them into existing meetings, or create them if necessary.
content.how_it_works:
Take meeting notes with Amie and let AI summarize them.

**Automatically add to Attio:**

1. Set up the "Automatic" sync method in Settings > Integrations > Attio
2. Once a summary is done, we look for meetings, people, companies
3. We add the summary everywhere relevant

**Manually add to Attio**

1. Once a summary is done, click Share > Attio.
2. Pick where in Attio to sync your note: Person, Company or Deal
content.configure:
1. Open Amie on macOS or Windows
2. Connect Attio in Settings > Integrations
3. Once it's connected, it will work for every Amie workspace member

title: Nomi
short_description: AI Sales Copilot: Real-time call guidance.

content.overview: Nomi is an AI helper for your business. It automatically handles meeting notes and CRM updates from customer calls, offering real-time suggestions during the conversation. This frees up your team to spend more time focusing on customer needs and building relationships.
content.how_it_works:
Nomi connects to your tools and works automatically:

1. Connect: Link Nomi to your work tools (calendar, meeting app like Zoom/Meet, CRM like Attio/Hubspot).
2. Joins Calls: Nomi automatically joins your online customer meetings from your calendar.
3. Takes Notes, Analyzes & Suggests: It listens and provides real-time suggestions during the call, writes everything down (transcribes), and uses AI post-call to create summaries, find action items, and understand customer feelings.
4. Updates CRM: Nomi automatically puts the meeting notes and summary into the correct customer record in your CRM.
5. Helps with Tasks: It can suggest follow-up tasks based on what was discussed in the call.
content.configure:
An admin can follow these steps to connect your Attio and Nomi accounts:

1. Find the 'Integrations' in 'Settings' menu in Nomi.
2. Choose your Calendar, Meeting app, and CRM, then click 'Connect' for each.
3. Follow the prompts to log in to those apps and give Nomi permission.
4. Nomi will show you when they're successfully connected

title: DialNext
short_description: Log calls and SMS activity to Attio records

content.overview:
DialNext is a customer communication platform that helps businesses manage calls and SMS from one place. It enables teams to make and manage customer calls, use a dialer for customer outreach, and send SMS messages as part of their communication workflow.

With the DialNext and Attio integration, teams can connect their DialNext account with Attio and log call and SMS activity to the relevant person records. This helps teams keep customer communication history organized and accessible alongside their customer information.

DialNext helps businesses streamline customer communication by bringing calling and SMS activity into their existing workflow. Teams can track relevant communication details, including call status, date and time, call duration, and SMS information, without manually recording each interaction.
content.how_it_works:
DialNext helps businesses manage customer communication through calling and SMS. With the DialNext and Attio integration, teams can connect their DialNext account with Attio and keep communication activity associated with the relevant person records.

Calling with DialNext

Use DialNext to make customer calls while working with your existing customer workflow. Once a call is completed, the call activity can be logged to the relevant person record in Attio.

SMS with DialNext

Send customer SMS messages through DialNext and keep the communication activity linked to the relevant person record in Attio. This helps teams maintain an organized history of customer conversations.

Communication details

Depending on the activity, DialNext can provide relevant communication details such as:

- Call status

- Date and time

- Call duration

- Answered by

- Call details

- SMS sender and recipient

- SMS date and time

- Message content
content.configure:
Connect DialNext with Attio to start logging your calling and SMS activity.

Follow these steps to integrate Attio with DialNext

1. Log in or sign up for your DialNext account.

2. Open Integrations from the left sidebar.

3. Find Attio in the integrations list and click Integrate.

4. Authorize the connection between DialNext and Attio.

5. Select the communication features you want to enable.

6. Save your integration settings.

7. Make a test call or send an SMS using DialNext.

8. Open the relevant person record in Attio to verify that the communication activity has been logged.

title: Speck
short_description: The Ambient Agent for Your Computer

content.overview: Speck helps professionals in back-to-back calls on their meeting tasks. It automates pre-call research, listens to every word, learns, and creates meeting notes, follow-ups, action items based on how you do them.
content.how_it_works:
Once installed, Speck acts as an ambient agent that monitors your screen and voice to provide contextual assistance during back-to-back calls. The AI proactively supports your workflow by conducting pre-call research, offering real-time guidance during calls, and handling post-call follow-ups.
Speck learns your preferences over time, understanding how you write emails, what information is important to you, and the context of your calls.
content.configure:
You must be a workspace admin and have a Speck account to connect the app.

**To get started:**

1. Click your workspace name in Attio.
2. Go to Workspace settings → Apps, then find Speck and click Install.
3. Click + Connect, sign into Speck, and authorize access.

title: Dialfyne
short_description: Bring Attio context into Dialfyne calls

content.overview: Dialfyne connects your Attio workspace to AI voice and dialer workflows so sales teams can call from Dialfyne while keeping people, companies, and deals in sync. After a call, Dialfyne can write a clear outcome note back onto the matching Attio person record, so reps do not have to copy-paste updates by hand. Use Dialfyne for outreach and coaching; keep Attio as the system of record for CRM data and follow-up context.
content.how_it_works:
1. An admin connects Attio from Dialfyne Integrations using secure OAuth.
2. Dialfyne syncs people, companies, and deals into the Dialfyne System read model so callers and coaches can work from current CRM context.
3. When a dialer call finishes, Dialfyne matches the lead by email or phone and creates a note on that Attio person with outcome, disposition, duration, and whether a meeting was booked.
4. You can reconnect or disconnect anytime from Dialfyne; tokens are handled through Nango so refresh stays automatic.
content.configure:
1. In Dialfyne Owner settings, enable the Attio connector for the workspace.
2. Go to Dialfyne → Integrations → Attio → Connect, then approve access in Attio.
3. Click Sync now to pull people, companies, and deals.
4. Ensure Attio people records have phone and/or email so call writeback can match the right person.
5. Make a test call from Dialfyne and confirm a note appears on the person in Attio.
Required Attio permissions: read object configuration, read records, and read/write notes.

title: Ringover
short_description: Turn every call & exchange into AI-powered Attio insights

content.overview: The Ringover integration for Attio bridges the gap between your conversations and your data. Built for high-growth sales and support teams, this integration eliminates manual data entry by automatically syncing every interaction and generating any call summary —calls, SMS, video calls and WhatsApp—directly into your Attio records

title: Cloudtalk
short_description: Auto-log calls, SMS & AI insights into Attio records

content.overview:
CloudTalk brings your team's phone conversations directly into Attio, so your CRM reflects every customer interaction without manual data entry.

Once connected, CloudTalk automatically logs calls — inbound, outbound, missed, and voicemail — and SMS to the right people along with CloudTalk's AI Conversation Intelligence: a summary, sentiment, and key topics, plus links to the recording and full call detail.

What sets CloudTalk apart is where that AI data lands. Instead of leaving AI insights trapped in a note, CloudTalk can write it into structured, filterable attributes on a call record — so you can filter, group, report, and build workflows on what was actually said, not just that a call happened.

You choose how calls are stored: as a structured Call object for teams that want to filter and report on call activity, or as simple notes for teams that want zero setup. Either way, contacts stay in sync and your reps stop copying call notes by hand.

title: KrispCall
short_description: KrispCall is a cloud telephony system for modern businesses.

content.overview: KrispCall is a cloud-based communications platform that enables businesses to make and receive calls, send SMS, and manage communications globally using virtual phone numbers. It provides a scalable and flexible solution for companies looking to enhance customer engagement and internal communications without relying on traditional telephony infrastructure.

title: Ringee.io
short_description: Make calls from Attio with Ringee and sync call activity

content.how_it_works:
1. Install the Ringee app in your Attio workspace.
2. Configure the app with your Ringee connection details.
3. Open a person or company record in Attio.
4. Use the **Call with Ringee** action to prepare a call.
5. The app validates the workspace configuration, resolves the correct Ringee context, and prepares a secure call session.
6. Ringee opens the dialer flow with the relevant record context.
7. Related call information can then be surfaced back inside Attio.

The app also includes an in-record widget that helps surface Ringee-related call information for the current record.
content.configure:
To use this app, you need:

- an active Ringee account
- access to the Ringee workspace or organization you want to use
- the Ringee integration token configured in the app settings
- the Ringee API URL configured if you are not using the default API environment

After installation:

1. Open the Ringee app settings inside Attio.
2. Enter your Ringee integration token.
3. Enter your Ringee API URL if needed.
4. Save the settings.
5. Test the connection from a supported record in Attio.

The app currently supports Attio as the active CRM provider in Ringee.

title: Caretta
short_description: Sales Call Assistant for Top Reps

content.overview: Caretta is a Sales Call Assistant that joins you in your Sales Calls and helps you answer any information request, question, or objection. Caretta's knowledge includes all of your accounts, previous sales calls, and your team's internal knowledge like scripts, playbooks, and product information.
content.how_it_works: Caretta integrates with Attio to pull account information (including notes), used to enrich it's knowledge on the call to give the best in-call assistance. After the call, Caretta pushes the call notes to the account/record.
content.configure: All users can integrate their Caretta to Attio. The integration can be done under Settings/Integrations/Attio.

title: CallPal
short_description: Power dialing and click-to-call on your own SIP trunk

title: Caret
short_description: Live answer copilot for enterprise tech sales

content.overview: Caret listens to your sales calls and surfaces real-time answers pulled from your docs, Attio, or past calls. It's like pressing 𝚌𝚝𝚛𝚕+𝚟 on your company’s knowledge into every rep – so anyone can sound like your best rep.
content.how_it_works:
Use Caret to take notes during your sales calls.

Before the call, click [Link CRM] and connect your Attio record.
Caret will pull the relevant information and gives you suggestion during the call.

When the meeting ends, Caret will add the notes to your Attio record.
content.configure: Open Caret app and navigate to Settings > Integrations > Attio. Click the [Connect] button and connect your account.

title: Reached
short_description: 3x more conversations, twice as fast.

content.how_it_works:
**Contacts** — Import your Attio contacts directly into Reached to start calling them instantly. Any new contact created or updated in Attio is automatically reflected in Reached in real-time.

**Call logs** — Every call made through Reached is automatically logged back into Attio, including call duration, outcome, and timestamp, keeping your CRM always up to date without any manual input.

**Notes** — Notes created during or after a call in Reached are synced directly into Attio, and notes added in Attio are visible in Reached before a call, giving your reps full context for every conversation.

**Tasks** — Tasks created in Reached are pushed to Attio so your team can follow up without switching tools. Tasks from Attio are also visible in Reached to keep your workflow centralized.

All data is synchronized in real-time in both directions, ensuring your sales team always works from up-to-date information across both platforms.
content.configure:
Once you're logged in on Reached, Click on your profile picture in the bottom left corner and then click "Settings".

- Go into "integrations"
- Once you’re on the Integrations page, find Attio and click on Connect.
- This will open the Activation window, which is where you will be prompted to connect.

title: Convo
short_description: Meeting intelligence that automates your follow-up work

content.overview: Convo listens to your meetings and helps you in real time with suggested responses, then handles everything after the call: summaries, action items, and follow-up emails drafted in 30 seconds. Connect it to Attio and every conversation shows up on the right contact or company record automatically.
content.how_it_works:
Convo runs during your calls on Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, or Slack, suggesting responses and letting you search your documents mid-conversation. 

Before the call, click [Link CRM] and connect your Attio record. Convo will pull the relevant context and give you suggestions during the conversation.

When the meeting ends, Convo will add the summary, action items, and a draft follow-up email to your Attio record.
content.configure:
1. Download Convo from [https://www.itsconvo.com](https://www.itsconvo.com) and create an account in the app.
2. Open the Convo desktop app and go to **Settings > Connections**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Attio. You'll be redirected to authorize Convo in your Attio workspace.
4. Once authorized, you'll be redirected back to Convo. Your workspace name will appear under the Attio card, confirming the connection.
5. After any meeting, open the conversation and click **Link CRM** in the share panel. Preview which contacts will be matched or created, then confirm to sync your meeting notes and action items to Attio.

title: Kallio
short_description: Connect Aircall, Dialpad, or 3CX: Calls, SMS, People

content.overview:
Kallio connects your phone system to Attio and logs every call and text message on the person it belongs to, without anyone typing anything up.

It is built for teams on Aircall, Dialpad or 3CX who keep their customers in Attio and want the phone to show up there too. Once it is switched on, each inbound, outbound or missed call becomes a note on the matching person record, with its direction, how long it lasted and who on your team handled it. Text messages are logged the same way. People stay in step in both directions, so a person added in Attio can be recognised by your phone system, and a new caller saved in your phone system appears in Attio.

Setup takes a few minutes and needs no technical work. You sign in to your phone system and to Attio, each in a popup, choose a plan, and switch the integration on. A dashboard shows every call as it is logged, and any call from a number Attio has never seen, so nothing goes missing.

Pricing is per workspace (not per user). 7 day free trial.
content.configure:
What you need

An Aircall, Dialpad or 3CX account you administer, an Attio account that can add apps to the workspace.

Connecting

1. Start from the install link.
2. Connect your phone system. 
3. On the CRM step, click Connect Attio. A popup opens on Attio. Sign in if you need to, pick the workspace Kallio should work in, check what it is asking for, and approve. 
4. Choose a plan and switch the integration on. People begin syncing straight away and calls are logged from then on.

Afterwards

Your Attio connection is listed on the Integration page under Your systems, with the workspace it is signed in as and Test and Disconnect alongside. 

The full guide, including what each error on the connect step means, is at getkallio.co/docs/attio/.

title: Knowzilla
short_description: Navigation for sales. Real-time AI that guides every deal

content.overview:
Knowzilla is expanding its enterprise capabilities to address critical gaps in the modern sales workflow. Currently, sales reps have to manually copy AI-generated meeting notes into their CRM, and our AI assistant starts every call with a "blank slate" regarding the account's history.

The Knowzilla integration for Attio solves the "amnesiac AI" problem by bridging the gap between your live sales conversations and your CRM records. By seamlessly pushing structured intelligence (summaries, pain points, goals, and blockers) directly into Attio, this integration eliminates manual data entry and ensures your team—and your AI—always have the most up-to-date context on every deal.
content.configure:
We designed this integration to be foolproof so your team can get started in seconds. To drive high adoption, Knowzilla relies entirely on Intelligent Defaults—there is no complex custom field-mapping UI to configure.

To connect Attio:

1. Navigate to your Knowzilla Admin Integrations Hub.
2. Locate and click on the Attio connection card.
3. You will be securely redirected to Attio to authorize the connection.

Once authorized, Knowzilla will handle the rest. Our system automatically queries your Attio workspace to map out your custom objects (people, companies, deals) and dynamically adapts to your specific pipeline stages behind the scenes. Just connect, and your AI meeting notes will start routing perfectly.

title: miniti
short_description: AI live meeting assistant and speech coach

content.overview: miniti is a meeting assistant and speech coaching app for macOS and iOS. It records meetings with live transcription, generates AI-powered summaries and action items, and coaches you in real-time on how you speak. Track filler words, talk ratio, pace, monologue length, questions asked, and clarity score across every meeting. Built for sales professionals who want to close more deals, and anyone who lives in meetings and wants to get sharper at them. The Attio integration lets you send meeting intelligence directly to your CRM records, keeping your workspace current without manual data entry. Pro plan at $5/month for 5,000 transcription minutes, or bring your own API keys for unlimited usage.
content.how_it_works:
miniti captures your meetings with live speech-to-text transcription, then runs AI analysis to produce summaries, action items, discussion flow, topic extraction, and MEDDPICC sales methodology analysis.

The speech coaching layer tracks per-speaker metrics in real-time: filler word frequency broken down by word, talk ratio, words-per-minute pace, longest monologue detection, questions asked, and an overall clarity score. Your full meeting history stores these training metrics so you can track improvement over time.

The Attio integration lets you send meeting data to any person or company record in your workspace. From any saved meeting in miniti, search for an Attio record and send summaries, discussion notes, action items, decisions, topics, MEDDPICC analysis, notes, and full transcripts as notes on that record. miniti remembers the selected target for each meeting to make repeat sends easy.
content.configure:
To connect your Attio account, use the "send to Attio" flow from a saved meeting in the macOS app.

1. In miniti, go to settings and enable the "sync to attio" feature.
2. Open a saved meeting in miniti on macOS.
3. Click "send to Attio."
4. Click "connect" and sign in to Attio in your browser.
5. Authorise miniti to access your Attio workspace.
6. Return to miniti after the connection completes.
7. Search for an Attio record (person or company) and select the target.
8. Click "send to Attio" to create notes on that record.

Once connected, you can search Attio records directly from miniti before sending, and miniti remembers the selected target for each meeting. the connection is OAuth-based with no manual API key entry required. available for macOS saved meetings with user-initiated export. to switch accounts, use the same flow and choose "reconnect" to reauthorise a different Attio workspace.

title: CallForges
short_description: Log every CallForges call in Attio automatically

content.overview:
CallForges is a cloud phone system and power dialer for sales teams. Reps make and take calls in the browser, run power and parallel dialing campaigns, and record and transcribe their conversations.

The CallForges app for Attio logs every call to the right person in Attio as soon as it ends, so your whole team can see each conversation on the person's timeline without typing a thing. It also brings your Attio people into CallForges, so reps can find and call them in one click.
content.configure:
1. In CallForges, open Integrations and choose Attio. You need permission to manage integrations in your CallForges workspace.

2. Click Connect, sign in to Attio, choose the workspace to connect and approve access. You return to CallForges with Attio connected.

3. Open Map users and match each CallForges user to their Attio member, or click Auto-map by e-mail, then save.

4. Open Settings to choose how each kind of call is logged, whether to create people for unknown numbers, whether notes include recording and transcript links, and which phone numbers are logged. Save your changes.

5. Optionally, use Log past calls to send earlier calls to Attio.

Your next call appears in Attio within about two minutes. You can disconnect at any time from the same page in CallForges.

title: HeyStream
short_description: The live streaming platform built for B2B growth

content.overview:
HeyStream is a B2B live streaming platform that helps teams run polished, branded broadcasts and turn audience engagement into measurable follow-up.

With the HeyStream app for Attio, contacts from your live broadcasts can be synced into Attio as people records when they register for or attend an event. HeyStream creates or updates people by email address, helping teams keep webinar and live-event audiences visible in their CRM without manual exports.

Use this integration to connect broadcast activity with your sales and marketing workflows, so event audiences are easier to track, segment, and follow up with after the live session.
content.how_it_works:
HeyStream syncs new broadcast contacts to Attio when someone registers for or attends a live broadcast.

For each synced person, HeyStream sends:

- Email address
- First name
- Last name
- Full name

HeyStream uses the email address to create or update the person record in Attio, so existing people are updated instead of duplicated. This will create or update people records in Attio so that you can include them in your central CRM and outbound marketing strategy.
content.configure:
You will need an active HeyStream workspace and an Attio workspace where you have permission to authorize apps and create or update people records.

To configure the app, connect Attio from your HeyStream workspace settings. After authorising HeyStream, contacts from supported broadcast events will sync automatically to Attio as people records.

title: SolarDialer
short_description: AI calls your Attio leads and logs every call

content.overview:
SolarDialer is an AI phone agent that calls your Attio people for you. Within minutes of a person joining a list you pick (or being added to your workspace), the agent calls them, reminds them what they asked about, answers their questions, and puts interested people through to your closer live, or books a callback for the time they ask.

Every call comes back to Attio: a note on the person with the outcome, an AI summary, the transcript and links to the recording; interested and transferred people added to the lists you pick; callbacks as tasks assigned to the Attio member who connected. It works for any business that follows up its leads by phone.
content.configure:
You need a SolarDialer account (sign up free at https://solardialer.net/signup?utm\_source=attio) and admin access to the Attio workspace you connect.

1. In SolarDialer, open Account > Integrations and click Connect Attio, then choose the workspace and allow access in Attio.

2. Under "Attio: <your workspace>", pick the list for interested people and, optionally, one for transferred people, and click Save.

3. Add a rule: an Attio list (or "Any new person") and the SolarDialer campaign those people join.

Calls are billed per minute in SolarDialer; the Attio connection itself is free. To disconnect, click Disconnect Attio: the token is revoked and the webhook removed. Questions: info@solardialer.net.

title: Backdrop
short_description: Live in-call sales copilot

content.overview: Backdrop is an AI copilot for live customer calls and meeting preparation. It helps reps answer technical and account questions using company knowledge, past calls, and connected tools. Connecting Attio brings relevant CRM context into Backdrop: the people and companies involved, deal information, and the notes and follow-ups from earlier conversations. Reps can ask questions about that context without leaving Backdrop.
content.configure:
Install the Backdrop desktop app from https://www.getbackdrop.ai/help/install and sign in.

Open Knowledge in the sidebar, find Attio, and click Connect on its card. In the Personal row, click Connect to open Attio's authorization page.

Sign in to Attio if needed, select your workspace, review the MCP permissions, and click Confirm. Return to Backdrop. When the Attio card shows For you, the connection is ready. Ask a question about an Attio record or note, or use the connection for meeting preparation and in-call questions.

To disconnect, open Knowledge, click Manage on the Attio card, and choose Disconnect in the Personal row, then confirm. Backdrop stops using that connection. You can also revoke access in Attio.

Full setup guide and walkthrough: https://www.getbackdrop.ai/help/integrations/personal/attio

title: EasyRinger
short_description: Place calls from Attio using your EasyRinger phone numbers

content.overview: EasyRinger is a virtual phone system for sales and support teams. This app lets you place a call to the phone number on a person record using your EasyRinger account. Open a person record that has a phone number, select the "Call with EasyRinger" record action, and the EasyRinger dialer opens in a new browser tab. Enter the number there and place the call, which runs in the browser using EasyRinger's own telephony infrastructure, no desk phone or SIM card required.
content.how_it_works: Open any person record in Attio that has a phone number, then select "Call with EasyRinger" from the record's actions menu. A dialog opens with a link labeled "Open EasyRinger Dialer". Select that link to open the dialer in a new browser tab, where you can place the call using your EasyRinger phone numbers. This action is available on person records only, since Attio's company records do not have a phone number field.
content.configure: No configuration is needed inside Attio itself. The first time you open the EasyRinger dialer, select "Connect Account" and sign in with your existing EasyRinger account. Once connected, the dialer remembers your account for future calls, so you will not need to sign in again on the same device.

title: Groovin
short_description: Sync your outreach channels to Attio

content.overview:
Groovin keeps Attio up to date with the relationship data your team creates while prospecting, without copy-paste or tab switching. It works the way connecting your email inbox to your CRM does: capture messages and new contacts, enrich them, and keep records current, all in the background.

Turn any professional profile into a clean Attio record in seconds, with email enrichment included. Keep contact details fresh as roles and companies change. 
Capture messages and connection request events to trigger Attio workflows that keep pipelines moving and follow-ups on time.

Built for relationship-driven teams (Sales, Founders, Venture Capital) who want their outreach reflected in Attio automatically.
content.configure:
1. Install the Groovin Chrome extension and pin it to your browser
2. Sign up to Groovin
3. Select Attio as your CRM
4. Confirm Groovin's access to your Attio workspace
5. Connect your social network account with one click

Once connected, you can access Groovin features directly within Attio.

*Groovin is not associated with, or endorsed by, the LinkedIn Corporation.*

title: Resend
short_description: Send emails and add contacts to segments from Attio

content.overview: Resend is an email API built for developers to send transactional and marketing email reliably. Connect Resend to Attio to turn your CRM data into email actions: create Resend contacts, add people to segments, and send emails with Resend templates, all triggered from Attio workflows and record actions.
content.how_it_works:
**Workflow blocks**

**Create contact:** This block creates a Resend contact. Give it an email address. You can also add a name and set the subscription status.

**Add contact to segment:** This block adds a Resend contact to a segment. Use a contact ID from an earlier step. Or search for a contact.

**Send email:** This block sends an email through Resend. Write the email as plain text. Or select a published template and fill in its variables. You can also set:

- CC addresses
- BCC addresses
- Reply-to addresses
- A send schedule
- Tags
- Attachments

**Record actions**

**Add to segment:** This action adds a person to a Resend segment. Open the person's record. Select Add to segment. Attio uses the person's email address. If the contact does not exist in Resend, Attio creates it.
content.configure:
In Attio, go to Workspace settings, select Apps and integrations from the sidebar, then search for and connect Resend. Enter a Resend API key when prompted to complete the connection.

Once connected, add the Create contact, Add contact to segment, or Send email steps to any workflow, or use the Add to segment action on any person record.

title: Slashy
short_description: AI-native email client with first-party Attio integration

content.overview:
Slashy is an AI-native email client built for teams who live in their inbox. With a first-party Attio integration, Slashy automatically keeps your CRM in sync as you communicate, turning every email into enriched contact data, tracked interactions, and actionable pipeline updates.

Designed from the ground up with AI at its core, Slashy helps you write faster, prioritize smarter, and never lose context. Connect your Attio workspace in seconds and watch your inbox and CRM work as one.
content.how_it_works:
Slashy's first-party Attio integration connects directly to your Attio workspace to sync email activity in real time. When you send or receive emails, Slashy automatically logs interactions against the relevant people and companies in Attio, updates contact records, and surfaces CRM context right inside your inbox.

The integration uses Attio's native APIs to ensure data accuracy and reliability. No middleware, no third-party connectors, just a direct and secure connection between your email and your CRM.
content.configure:
To get started, you will need an active Slashy account. Connect your Attio workspace from the Slashy settings panel by authorizing access via OAuth. Once connected, Slashy will begin syncing your email activity with Attio automatically.

You can customize sync preferences, such as which inboxes to track and which Attio lists to update, directly from your Slashy settings.

title: Kondo
short_description: Superhuman for LinkedIn DMs

content.overview: Kondo is a productivity layer for LinkedIn DMs that helps sales and marketing teams manage conversations, stay organized, and sync key context into Attio automatically.
content.how_it_works:
The Kondo <> Attio integration allows you to

- Sync DMs to the People activity feed as notes
- Sync fields from Kondo such as labels, notes, and URL to Attio People properties
- Add links to Attio and other Attio fields to the Kondo side panel

### [​](https://docs.trykondo.com/attio-integration#configuration)
content.configure:
1. To connect Kondo to Attio, go to Settings -> Integrations -> Attio or click [this link](https://app.trykondo.com/integrations/attio) to connect and authenticate with an Attio admin account
2. Configure mapping for Kondo -> Attio

    - We map records in Kondo to Attio records by using the contact’s LinkedIn URL as an identifier.
    - Toggle ‘Sync Messages’ if you want to add DMs as Notes to the activity feed. If you leave this toggled off, only fields will sync.
    - Toggle ‘Sync Contacts’ if you want new Contacts to be created if one with a matching LinkedIn URL is not found.
    - Edit optional field mapping below if you want to map other Kondo properties to your own Attio custom fields

3. Configure fields to pull from Attio -> Kondo

Kondo will display a link to the matching Attio contact in the right side panel by default. You can optionally add additional fields to pull from Attio people records into the Kondo side panel.

title: Telegram
short_description: Send Telegram messages and start workflows from bot commands

content.overview:
Connect a Telegram bot to Attio. Use the bot in workflows to send messages, send polls, and add emoji reactions to messages.

Start a workflow when the bot receives a specific command in a chat. Start a workflow when a person joins or leaves a chat.
content.configure:
### Create a Telegram bot

1. In Telegram, open a chat with @BotFather.

2. Send the command /newbot.

3. Send a display name for the bot.

4. Send a username for the bot. The username must end in "bot", for example acme\_bot.

5. Copy the token that BotFather sends.

### Connect the bot to Attio

1. Install the Telegram app.

2. Go to Workspace settings → Apps → Telegram.

3. Find Workspace connection and click Connect.

4. Paste the BotFather token.

5. Submit the dialog.


### Add the bot to your chats

1. For a private chat, send /start to the bot.

2. For a group, add the bot as a member.

3. In the group, send a command to the bot, for example /notify.

4. In the workflow block, select the chat in the Chat field.

title: Scribeless
short_description: Send direct mail from Attio

content.overview:
Make business feel more personal and turn important customer moments into direct mail. With Scribeless, sales, marketing and customer success teams can send handwritten notes, cards, letters, and postcards directly from Attio, using your contact data to personalize each send.

Use Scribeless to follow up after meetings, revive stalled opportunities, thank customers, support renewals, and stand out with prospects when email is not enough.

With the
content.how_it_works:
After the app is installed, an admin connects a Scribeless API key as the workspace connection. Once connected, users can: 

1. Automatically send mail from attio Workflows
2. Find postal address data for recipients
3. Trigger follow up actions from QR code scans
4. Send 1-off mail from contact records
5. Track campaign performance
content.configure: Install the app in your Attio workspace, then connect it to Scribeless with a Scribeless API key. The key is validated with Scribeless and used server-side to load available campaigns and create recipients. You need an active Scribeless account, at least one recurring or test campaign, and people records with the postal fields required by the campaign. Keep workflow triggers narrow while testing because successful runs create real Scribeless recipients.

title: Housecat
short_description: Never update your CRM again

content.overview:
Add or update records in your Attio CRM right from your inbox.

Housecat is a new type of email inbox that links directly to your Attio CRM. It brings key information from your CRM into your email, so you can immediately see if a company is already in Attio, what stage a deal is at, or who owns the relationship.

From any email, ask Housecat to create a new record or update an existing one. Housecat reads the conversation, extracts the important details, and makes the changes in Attio for you.

Every update includes a clear summary of what changed, along with any conflicts, errors, or possible duplicates that need your attention. Changes are easy to review, correct, or undo.

Housecat is built for teams that want an accurate CRM without the manual data entry
content.configure:
Housecat takes less than 5 minutes to set up:

1. Setup your Housecat email inbox Connect gmail or other supported mail providers at https://home.housecat.com 
2. Connect your Attio workspace Authorize Housecat to read, create and update records in Attio.
3. Housecat maps your existing Attio configuration We read your existing fields to understand how to update them. If you have custom objects you can choose how we map data against them.
4. Get your Housecat forwarding address You receive a unique email address that your team can forward relevant emails to.

title: Skylar
short_description: Practice before the call - don’t burn the deal.

content.overview:
With Attio and Skylar, your reps can run the call before the call - with the *actual prospect* they’re about to speak with.

Skylar uses real-time context from Attio - people, companies, deals, notes, and past conversations - to generate realistic, tailored roleplays. Reps rehearse the conversation, get instant feedback, and head into the real call sharp and ready.
content.configure:
You must be a workspace admin and have a [Skylar](https://www.getskylar.com/) account to connect the app.

1. Click your workspace name in Attio.
2. Go to Workspace settings → Apps, then find Skylar AI Roleplays and click Install.
3. Click + Connect, sign into Skylar, and authorize access.
4. You’re ready to go - open any contact in Attio and start preparing your next call.

title: Onbox
short_description: Email for people who move hundreds of small cases a day

content.overview: Onbox is an email client designed for professionals who handle dozens or hundreds of small cases daily from their inbox. Whether you work in insurance, property management, accounting, logistics, HR, or operations, Onbox lets you search for context, check documents, update your tools, and reply—all directly from your inbox. No more switching between systems.
content.how_it_works: Onbox connects to your Attio workspace to bring CRM context directly into your email workflow. When you receive an email, Onbox surfaces relevant contact and deal information from Attio, so you can review, update, and respond without leaving your inbox.
content.configure: To get started, connect your Attio workspace from the Onbox integrations settings. Authorize the connection, and Onbox agent will be able to take actions (read and write) to your Attio contacts and records directly from your inbox.

title: HeyReach
short_description: Centralize your LinkedIn outreach from HeyReach in Attio

content.overview:
This application creates an easily configured automation to sync data between HeyReach and Attio. Push Attio person records to HeyReach campaigns and lists, from record actions or from your own workflows, or stream HeyReach campaign events into Attio based on the events you choose in the workspace settings.

Log events as activities on each person's timeline and on their deals, in a dedicated HeyReach Events list, or both. 

### Finding this app useful?

We welcome feedback and would love to hear any ideas you have for what to build next. [Drop us a note](https://neondeerdata.com/contact-us/?utm_source=attio-sdk--hey-reach). If you're looking for other useful apps we've published, check out [Duplicate Detection](https://attio.com/apps/check-for-duplicates), [Advanced Workflow Automations](https://attio.com/apps/workflow-utilities), or explore everything we offer on the [Neon Deer platform](https://neondeerdata.com/platform/?utm_source=attio-sdk--hey-reach) to learn more.
content.configure:
This app will work on all Attio plans (Free, Plus, Pro, and Enterprise). Syncing data to activities may require a paid plan in Attio, but syncing to lists is available on the free tier.

1. Click "Install" to install this app in Attio
2. Log in to HeyReach and get your API key (Settings → Integrations → HeyReach API). The blacklist step requires a workspace-level key.
3. Go to your Attio workspace's Settings → Apps → HeyReach
4. Click Connect, paste in the API key and click Save
5. Open the app's settings and, under "Where events are logged", click "Set up activities", "Set up events list" or both. Setup takes up to 30 seconds.
6. Choose which events you want to listen for

title: TimelinesAI WhatsApp Integration
short_description: Two-way WhatsApp messaging inside your Attio records

content.overview:
TimelinesAI is a shared WhatsApp inbox for teams — it connects your business WhatsApp numbers so your whole team can message customers from one place. This app links TimelinesAI to Attio so every WhatsApp conversation is reflected on the right person automatically, and so your team can start WhatsApp messages without leaving Attio.

Inbound messages are matched to a person by phone number and saved as a note. Outbound messages are sent on a one-to-one, contact-initiated basis by adding a person to a list, or with the in-record Send WhatsApp action. No copy-paste and no tab-switching — your WhatsApp activity lives next to the rest of your customer context, on the records you already work in.

TimelinesAI is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. "WhatsApp" is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.
content.how_it_works:
Inbound — WhatsApp becomes a note. When someone messages one of your connected WhatsApp numbers, the app finds the matching person by phone number — creating one if there is no match — and adds a note with the message. Duplicate deliveries are ignored and an existing person is reused, so you never get duplicate people or notes.

Outbound — from a list or in-record. Send by adding a person to the "Send WhatsApp" list, or click the in-record Send WhatsApp action and reply from a composer right on the record. The message goes through TimelinesAI from your connected number and is recorded as a note.

Keeping records tidy. When two people are merged, the app re-parents its WhatsApp notes onto the surviving record so conversation history is never lost. A daily health check confirms the connection is still authorized.
content.configure:
1. Connect TimelinesAI: in TimelinesAI, make sure the WhatsApp numbers you want to mirror are connected and your team has access.

2. Install in Attio: start the install from this listing and approve the connection. On connect, the app automatically creates the "Send WhatsApp" list, adds the WhatsApp Phone and WhatsApp Message attributes to the people object, and registers a secure webhook — there is nothing to wire up by hand.

3. Use it: inbound messages start appearing as notes on the matching person immediately. To send, add a person to the "Send WhatsApp" list, or use the in-record Send WhatsApp action. You can disconnect at any time from the app's settings page, which removes the webhook and the data the app created.

title: SuperLinkIn
short_description: Keep contacts and conversations connected to Attio

content.overview:
SuperLinkIn helps you organize professional conversations and keep their context in Attio.

Use keyboard shortcuts, labels, snooze, search, and saved replies to manage your inbox. Sync conversations to Attio so your team can read the message history alongside the corresponding person record, without copying messages between tabs.

Sync manually when needed, or enable auto-sync for conversations you open.
content.how_it_works:
**Contact matching**

SuperLinkIn looks for an existing person in Attio using their profile URL or a matching attribute you configure. If no match is found, it creates a person record with their name and profile URL.

**Conversation notes**

Available conversation messages are saved as a note on the person record, including sender names and timestamps. The note also includes the contact’s profile link and headline when available.

When newer messages are synced, SuperLinkIn refreshes the conversation note.

**Sync controls**

Sync a conversation manually, or enable auto-sync to sync conversations after you open them and their messages load. You can disable auto-sync for individual conversations.

The integration is designed for one-to-one conversations. Group conversation sync is not supported.
content.configure:
- Install the SuperLinkIn Chrome extension and open SuperLinkIn.
- Go to Settings and open Integrations.
- Choose Attio and authorize access to your workspace.
- Review your contact-matching settings. Use default profile matching or select an existing attribute containing profile URLs or usernames.
- Open a one-to-one conversation and click **Sync to Attio**. Enable auto-sync in Integrations if you want conversations synced when opened.

title: Salesmsg
short_description: Texting, calling, and AI-powered conversations for Attio

content.overview:
Salesmsg brings SMS, MMS, voice calling, and AI-powered conversations directly into Attio so teams can engage leads and customers in real time without leaving their CRM.

With Salesmsg, Attio users can send text messages, make calls, and automate follow-ups while keeping every conversation automatically synced to contact records. Teams can manage conversations through personal or shared inboxes, ensuring full visibility and collaboration across the organization.

By adding messaging and calling to Attio workflows, Salesmsg helps teams respond faster, maintain organized communication history, and turn CRM contacts into real conversations that drive pipeline and customer relationships.
content.how_it_works:
1. **Connect Salesmsg to Attio**
Install the Salesmsg integration and securely connect it to your Attio workspace. Contacts and communication activity stay synced between both platforms.
2. **Text and Call from Salesmsg**
Send SMS or MMS messages and make voice calls directly from Salesmsg to your Attio contacts. Conversations happen in real time while remaining linked to the correct contact.
3. **Automatically Log Conversations**
Every message, reply, and call is automatically recorded in Salesmsg, giving your team a complete history of customer communication without manual updates.
4. **Manage Conversations as a Team**
Use personal or shared inboxes to organize conversations across reps and ensure every lead or customer message gets a response.
content.configure:
**Pricing**

Salesmsg offers flexible, usage-based pricing depending on messaging and calling volume.

**Free Trial**

New users can start with a **14-day free trial** to test SMS, MMS, calling, and automation features.

**Setup**

Install the integration, connect your Salesmsg account, choose a phone number, and start texting or calling Attio contacts.

**Requirements**

Active **Salesmsg account**, **Attio workspace**, and a messaging-enabled phone number.

title: Bird
short_description: Message your customers across channels from Attio

content.overview:
Bird brings customer messaging into Attio. Send SMS, WhatsApp and email from a person record, or reach the people associated with a company, deal or lead. Select multiple people to compose an SMS or email once and send it to each recipient.

Add a person, or a whole selection of people, to a Bird audience from their record, or as a step in a workflow. Bird matches or creates the contact from the person's email address and phone number, and sets the contact's name from the person's when it creates one, so nobody handles a Bird contact ID.

Use Bird in Attio Workflows to automate SMS, WhatsApp and email sends. Start workflows when messages arrive, delivery succeeds or fails, or recipients open or click an email.

Add the Bird conversation widget to your records to read recent messages alongside your CRM data, including messages sent through other Bird tools. Open a message to compose a response. With a conversation mailbox configured, you can also read received email and reply in its thread.

title: Workspace Email Notifications
short_description: Send email alerts to workspace members via Attio workflows

title: Faqir
short_description: Your FAQs, Automated

content.overview:
Faqir is an AI assistant that creates amazing FAQ pages that help you sell.

It scan call recordings stored in your Attio account to identify repeat questions your customers ask. Using your team’s actual replies, Faqir drafts clear, SEO-friendly answers that you can review, edit, and publish in a click.
content.how_it_works:
1. Scan all customer call transcripts stored in Attio account to detect repeat buyer questions.
2. Draft clear answers based on your past replies from call transcript in Attio.
3. Publish FAQ hub on your subdomain.
content.configure:
Note that you will need to have an Attio Pro account and to be an Attio workspace administrator to complete the integration setup.

1. Log into your Faqir **account**, or create a new account.
2. Click **’Data Source’** in the Faqir dashboard.
3. Click **Connect** under Attio, then **Authorize** on the Attio Authorization page.

title: Memoket
short_description: Send meeting notes from Memoket to Attio

content.overview: Memoket turns conversations into structured meeting content and helps keep customer context close to the records your team uses in Attio. Send recording briefs, summaries, and transcripts from Memoket as notes linked to existing people or company records. Keep meeting details alongside customer information so your team can review discussions and follow up with the right context.
content.how_it_works:
Connect your Attio workspace to Memoket, then choose an existing person or company as the destination for a recording. Select the brief, summary, and/or transcript in Memoket and send the selected content to Attio. Memoket creates notes linked to the chosen record, where your team can review the conversation.

The integration reads existing people and company records for destination selection and adds notes to the selected record. It does not create people or company records or edit their attributes.
content.configure:
You need a Memoket account and permission to connect an Attio workspace and access the existing people or company records you want to use.

1. Open the integrations section in Memoket and select Attio.

2. Choose Connect and complete Attio's authorization flow for your workspace.

3. Return to Memoket and open a processed recording.

4. Choose Attio as the destination, then select an existing person or company record.

5. Select the content to send and confirm.

If a record is unavailable, confirm that you connected the correct Attio workspace and have access to that record.

title: Recordkite
short_description: Get your customer Slack conversations in Attio

title: Postlude
short_description: Send follow-up emails in your own voice after every call

content.overview: Postlude turns sales calls into sent follow-up emails. When a call ends, Postlude receives the transcript from Fathom, drafts a follow-up in the rep’s own voice, and queues it for review. The rep edits if needed and sends from their own Gmail — the email comes from them, not from a tool. The moment it sends, Postlude logs it to Attio: it finds the person by email address (or creates them if they’re new) and attaches a note with who it went to, the subject, and the full text. Your Attio timeline stays complete without anyone typing a call summary. Built for small agencies and sales teams who win deals on speed of follow-up.
content.how_it_works:
### Drafts from real calls

A Fathom webhook fires when a call ends. Postlude reads the transcript and drafts a follow-up that reflects what was actually discussed — commitments made, next steps, links you always include.

### Your voice, not a template

Each team member gets a voice profile built from emails they’ve actually sent, so drafts sound like the rep, not like AI.

### Send from your own Gmail

Reps review, edit, and send through their connected Gmail account. Postlude never sends on its own.

### Logged to Attio automatically

On send, Postlude matches each recipient to a person in Attio by email address, creating the person if they don’t exist, and adds one note per sent email. It never modifies existing records and never reads your notes.
content.configure:
1. Create a Postlude account at app.postlude.ai and connect Fathom from the setup page.
2. Connect Attio: click Connect next to Attio, approve the requested permissions, and choose your workspace. Postlude requests only what it needs — creating or finding people and writing notes.
3. Connect Gmail when you’re ready to send.
4. That’s it. After your next call, a draft appears; when you send it, the email is logged to Attio within seconds. You can check every log in the workspace timeline.

title: Salespeak Inbound AI
short_description: Website AI conversations and leads, synced into Attio

content.overview:
Salespeak is an AI sales agent that answers buyers' questions on your website, qualifies them, and captures their contact details. It is trained on your own product, pricing and positioning, so every answer matches how your team sells.

This app connects Salespeak to your Attio workspace. Every conversation with a known email lands in Attio as a person and a company, with a note summarizing what the buyer asked, their intent, and a link to the full conversation. Your team sees who is evaluating you, and why, without leaving Attio.
content.how_it_works:
When a visitor shares their email in a Salespeak conversation, Salespeak creates or updates the person in Attio, matched on email address, and their company, matched on domain. Names and fields your team already edited are never overwritten.

Salespeak adds a note to the person with the conversation summary, the buyer's intent, the page they engaged on, and a link to the full conversation. Later messages in the same conversation update the same note.

Every Salespeak lead is marked with two attributes, Salespeak lead and Salespeak last conversation, so you can filter and build views on them. You can also have leads added to a list you choose, and map answers from the conversation (for example role, use case or timeline) to person or company attributes.

Salespeak reads a returning visitor's Attio record to personalize the conversation, and can alert your team in Slack or email when a visitor matches rules on their Attio attributes.
content.configure:
Before you start, you need a Salespeak account with the AI agent live on your website, and an Attio workspace admin to approve the connection.

Step 1. In Salespeak, open Integrations and select Attio.

Step 2. Connect your workspace. Attio asks you to pick a workspace and approve access.

Step 3. Back in Salespeak, the page shows "Connected to Attio". Salespeak adds two attributes to people in your workspace, Salespeak lead and Salespeak last conversation.

Step 4 (optional). Under "Add leads to list", pick the list that new leads should join.

Step 5 (optional). On the Person and Company tabs, map conversation details to your own attributes. On the Notifications tab, choose which people and companies trigger an alert when they start a conversation.

There is nothing else to install. From then on, every conversation with a known email syncs to Attio. To disconnect, remove the Attio integration in Salespeak. This also revokes Salespeak's access to your workspace.

title: Blujay
short_description: Text your leads with iMessage directly from Attio

content.overview:
Text your leads with iMessage right from their Attio record. Open the Messages tab to see the full conversation and reply from your Blujay number, or start a new one. No switching apps, no copying numbers.

Every conversation is logged where your team works. Texts show on the person's timeline with the channel and the teammate who sent them. Calls show with their outcome, length and full transcript.

Put iMessage to work in your Attio workflows. Send a text as a workflow step, or start a workflow when a lead texts you back.

New people added to Attio can become Blujay contacts automatically, ready to text.
content.how_it_works:
1. Connect Blujay to Attio in a few clicks, then match your Attio teammates to their Blujay accounts so every conversation is credited to the right person.

2. Open any person in Attio and text them from the Messages tab, using your Blujay number. Your whole history with them is right there.

3. Every text and call lands on the person's timeline automatically. Texts show who sent them and how, and calls come with the full transcript, so your team always knows where each lead stands.

4. New people you add to Attio sync to Blujay automatically, ready for their first text.
content.configure:
You'll need a Blujay account. A Blujay owner or admin sets it up once for the whole team:

1. In Blujay, go to Settings, then Integrations, and click Connect on the Attio card.

2. In Blujay's Attio settings, match each Attio teammate to their Blujay account.

3. In Attio, open any person, click Configure page, and add the Messages tab.

Each teammate then connects their own Blujay account the first time they open the Messages tab.

If your Attio plan can't show Blujay texts, Blujay tells you on its Attio card.

title: Hazelchat
short_description: Turn website chat enquiries into people with notes

content.overview:
Hazelchat is an AI chat agent for your website. It answers visitors from your own pages and the sources you approve, shows where each answer came from, and says so when it doesn't know. When a visitor wants to hear from you, Hazelchat takes their enquiry.

With the Hazelchat app, every new enquiry from your website chat goes straight to Attio. Hazelchat finds the visitor in your people by email address, or adds them, and attaches a note with what they asked and where they came from. You reply with the whole conversation in view, without copying anything over from an inbox.
content.configure:
## Connect

1. Sign in to Hazelchat, or start at hazelchat.co and set up your website chat.
2. In Hazelchat, open Connections, choose Attio and click Connect Attio.
3. Approve the connection in Attio. A workspace admin needs to approve it.

New enquiries from your website chat appear in Attio within seconds.

## Requirements

Sending enquiries to Attio is part of Hazelchat's paid plans. Visitor details must be on in Hazelchat under Data & privacy.

## Disconnect

Click Disconnect Attio in Hazelchat to stop sending and give back Hazelchat's access. To remove the app completely, uninstall it in Attio's settings. People and notes already in Attio stay there.

title: Fin
short_description: Give Fin live access to your Attio CRM data

content.overview:
Connect Fin and Attio to make your AI support agent, smarter and your CRM richer.

When customers ask Fin questions like "What's my account status?" or "Can you update my contact details?", Fin can look up or update the right record in Attio in real time - no human handoff needed.

Whether you're automating customer support with Fin or enriching Attio records with real conversation history, this integration keeps both platforms in sync.
content.how_it_works:
**Fin answers questions using live Attio data** 

Fin can call the Attio API mid-conversation to fetch or update CRM records on behalf of a customer. Using Data connectors — Intercom's no-code tool for connecting Fin to external services — you point Fin at any Attio endpoint (contacts, deals, companies, and more). Fin decides when to call it based on what the customer asks, or you can place it in a Workflow for precise control.

**Examples of what Fin can do:**

- Look up a customer's deal stage when they ask about their account
- Retrieve company or contact details from Attio to personalise a response
- Update an Attio record when a customer requests a change
content.configure:
**Requirements**

- An active Intercom workspace
- An Attio account
- Admin access in Intercom to configure integrations

**Setup**

1. Connect Fin to Attio in Intercom under [Settings > Integrations > Authentication](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/settings/app-settings/authentication) - choose Attio in the Add token dropdown.
2. In Intercom, go to [Settings > Integrations > Data](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/settings/app-settings/custom-actions) connectors and create a new connector. You can read more about data connectors in Intercom [here](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/9916497-how-to-set-up-data-connectors).
3. In the Authentication tokens section, select the Attio token that was created in step 1.
4. Configure the Attio API endpoint you want Fin to call (for example, to look up contacts or deals).
5. Test the connection, then set the connector live.

title: Plain
short_description: Sync Attio CRM data into Plain for customer context

content.overview: Bring your Attio CRM into Plain so your support team has full customer context on every conversation. Companies, people, and attributes sync automatically, so customer information in Plain is always up to date.
content.how_it_works:
- Companies → Tenants. Each Attio company becomes a Plain tenant. 
- People → Customers. Each person on a synced company is imported as a customer and linked to their tenant. 
- Company attributes → Tenant fields. Attio attributes appear as tenant fields in Plain — choose which are visible, and optionally pick one (e.g. a "Plan" field) to drive Plain tiers, with a tier created for each value and kept in sync.
- Continuous sync. After the initial import, changes in Attio flow through to Plain automatically. 
- List-scoped. You pick a single Attio list to sync from, so only the companies and people you care about come across.
content.configure:
1. In Plain, go to Settings → Attio.
2. Click Connect with Attio and authorize access in the popup.
3. Select the Attio list to import from.
4. Click Import from list to start the sync.
5. (Optional) Under Configure fields, toggle which Attio attributes appear in Plain.

title: SparrowDesk
short_description: AI-first customer support for modern teams.

content.configure: To use the SparrowDesk integration, make sure you have access to both your Attio workspace and a SparrowDesk account. Install the SparrowDesk app from Attio’s Apps & Integrations section and connect your workspace. Once connected, SparrowDesk will begin sending ticket details to Attio automatically. Contacts in Attio’s People list are used to link tickets, allowing support conversations to appear under the relevant person’s profile without any additional configuration.

title: Productlane
short_description: Push support conversations and contacts to Attio

content.overview:
Productlane is a customer support platform for engineering teams. This integration connects Productlane with Attio, so your support and revenue teams work from the same customer record. Support conversations that happen in Productlane show up for the matching person and company in Attio, and keep the contacts and companies you manage in Productlane present in Attio.

Support agents keep the full picture of each customer. Sales and success teams can see recent support activity alongside the account context they already track in Attio, without switching tools.

The connection is one-directional and only ever creates records: Productlane writes to Attio and never imports Attio records back, so your Attio data stays clean, and nothing your team curated gets overwritten. Companies are matched by domain and people by email address, so the same customer stays linked across both tools.
content.how_it_works:
Authorizing the app runs a first sync that pushes your Productlane companies and contacts to Attio, and the connection then keeps Attio updated on an ongoing basis.

Company and contact sync (Productlane to Attio, create-only):

- Every Productlane company with a domain becomes a company in Attio, and every Productlane contact that belongs to a company becomes a person in Attio.
- New contacts and companies you add in Productlane sync to Attio as you create them.
- Attio records are never imported into Productlane, so your workspace stays free of unrelated CRM data.

Daily activity notes:

- Once a day, Productlane writes a single note to the matching person and company for each thread that received new messages.
- The note lists that day's messages and links back to the full conversation in Productlane.
- System messages, AI auto-replies, and delivery confirmations are filtered out, so the record stays readable.
content.configure:
Requirements:

- A Productlane workspace on the Pro plan or higher.
- An Attio workspace, with an Attio admin to authorize the connection.

Setup:

- In Productlane, go to Settings, then Integrations, then Attio.
- Click Connect and authorize Productlane to access your Attio workspace.
- You are returned to Productlane and the first sync starts automatically. It pushes your companies and contacts to Attio; after that, changes are kept up to date on an ongoing basis.

Disconnect any time from Settings, then Integrations, then Attio. Records and notes already created in Attio stay in place; new activity stops syncing.

title: Cevanos
short_description: AI customer service that knows your Attio customers

content.overview: Cevanos is an AI customer-service agent that answers your customers across chat, email, WhatsApp and voice, and acts on their behalf inside the systems you already run. Connecting Attio lets the agent recognise who it is talking to: it finds the customer's person record by their email address before it answers, so it can use what your team already knows instead of asking them to repeat themselves. It can also create the customer's record when one does not exist yet, keep their details current, and log a note of the conversation on their record so your team sees what happened.
content.configure: You need a Cevanos workspace and an Attio user who can approve app access for your Attio workspace. In the Cevanos console, open Integrations, choose Attio and click Connect; you will be sent to Attio to approve access and then returned to Cevanos. No API keys or settings need to be copied. The agent only uses Attio for customers it has identified by email, and any write it makes follows the approval rules you set in Cevanos. To stop the integration, disconnect Attio in the Cevanos console or uninstall the app from your Attio workspace.

title: BubblaV
short_description: AI support assistant

content.overview:
BubblaV is an intelligent AI chatbot that lives on your website, trained on your unique content to answer visitor questions instantly. This integration bridges the gap between your website traffic and your Attio.

**Key Features:**

- **Auto-Capture:** instantly turns chat participants into Attio Person records.
- **Context Rich:** Saves the full chat transcript to the record so your sales team knows exactly what the prospect is interested in.
- **Smart Enrichment:** Automatically links People to Companies based on email domains.
content.how_it_works:
The integration works silently in the background to keep your Attio up to date with your site activity.

1. **Engage:** A visitor starts a conversation with the BubblaV widget on your website. The AI answers their questions based on your documentation and site content.
2. **Identify:** During the chat, if the visitor provides their email address (either proactively or when asked by the bot), BubblaV identifies them as a lead.
3. **Sync:** BubblaV immediately checks your Attio workspace:

    - **If the Person exists:** It updates their record with the latest activity and chat transcript.
    - **If they are new:** It creates a new Person record and automatically associates them with a Company based on their email domain.

4. **Handover:** Your sales team sees the new lead in Attio immediately, complete with the context of their conversation, allowing for a hyper-personalized follow-up.
content.configure:
Setting up the BubblaV integration is quick and requires no coding.

1. **Install the App:** Click the **"Install"** button in the top right corner of this listing.
2. **Authorize Access:** You will be prompted to allow BubblaV to access your Attio workspace. This is required so we can create and update records on your behalf.
3. **Connect BubblaV:** Once installed, you will be redirected to your BubblaV dashboard. Select the specific website you want to connect to this Attio workspace.
4. **Done:** The integration is now live. All future conversations will automatically sync to Attio.
5. In Attio, navigate to a Person, then click the menu on the top right, choose "**Configure page"** and click "**Add widget**" button to add the "**BubblaV Insights**" widget. This displays the online status of a person, all conversations and the ability to start a "**Live Chat**".

title: Asyntai AI Chatbot
short_description: AI chat that answers your website visitors

content.overview:
Asyntai puts an AI assistant on your website. It answers your visitors day and night, in 36 languages, from your own product pages, help pages and documents. When a visitor asks something the assistant cannot answer, it asks for an email address and passes the question to your team.

This app brings those chats into Attio. Open a person, and you see every chat that person had on your website, with the full text of every message. Your team reads what the visitor already asked before they reply, so nobody asks the same question twice, and the first answer is the right one.

Two places show the history. A record widget on a person shows how many chats that email address had. A record action opens the chats themselves, newest first, with the page the visitor was on.
content.how_it_works:
When you open a person record, the app takes the email address on that record. It asks the Asyntai API for the chats where a visitor left that same address, and for the messages of those chats.

The record widget "Asyntai chats" counts the chats of that contact, and opens them when you press it. The record action "View Asyntai chats" opens the same history from the record menu.

The workflow trigger "New Asyntai lead" starts a workflow the moment a visitor leaves their contact details, so Attio creates the person and keeps the conversation with it.

Your Asyntai API key lives in the Attio connection of the app, and every call runs in a server function inside Attio.
content.configure:
You need an Asyntai account. Creating one is free. The Asyntai API needs a Starter plan or higher, so the app needs that plan as well.

1. Sign in at asyntai.com, open Settings, then API, and copy your API key.

2. In Attio, open Settings, then Apps, find Asyntai AI Chatbot, and press Install.

3. Press Connect, paste your API key into the Add connection dialog, and press Add connection.

4. Open any person record. The action "View Asyntai chats" is in the record menu.

To add the widget as well, open the record menu, choose Configure page, press Add widget, and choose Asyntai chats.

To create people from new leads, create a workflow with the trigger "New Asyntai lead" and the step "Create or update record" on People.

A person shows their chats when the email address on the Attio record is the address the visitor left in the chat on your website.

title: ScreenReply
short_description: Request or capture instant screen recordings in one click

content.overview:
ScreenReply makes it effortless to capture and share exactly what's happening on the screen. Request recordings from customers to troubleshoot complex issues, or record quick updates yourself—all directly in the browser with no software required.

Connect ScreenReply to Attio to generate recording links straight from any Person or Company record. Once a customer finishes recording, the video link is automatically logged as a Note on their profile. This link opens a smart player equipped with an AI-generated summary and clickable timecodes, helping your team understand the problem in seconds.
content.configure:
1. **Install the app** - Browse the official Attio App Store, locate the ScreenReply listing, and click the Install button.
2. **Connect to ScreenReply** - Log in to your existing account or register a new profile, then navigate to the Integrations section from the main menu.
3. **Authorize the integration** - Search for the Attio module and click Connect. Review the requested permission scopes in the OAuth window and authorize ScreenReply to securely interact with your CRM data.
4. **Get your connection token** - Click Setup on the Attio integration card in ScreenReply and copy your proprietary authentication token to your clipboard.
5. **Connect to Attio** - Return to your Attio environment, access the configuration settings for the installed ScreenReply app, and paste your token into the Workspace connection input field to finalize the setup.

title: Unthread
short_description: AI support in Slack

content.overview: Unthread's is an AI support platform built into Slack. Using Unthread's Attio app allows you sync customer conversations to the proper Attio account as well as sync Attio properties back into your Unthread account.
content.how_it_works: Unthread's is an AI support platform built into Slack. Using Unthread's Attio app allows you sync customer conversations to the proper Attio account as well as sync Attio properties back into your Unthread account.

title: Clay
short_description: Go to market with unique data — and the ability to act on it

content.overview:
Clay is an AI-driven data enrichment and go-to-market orchestration platform that helps revenue teams find, qualify, and act on prospects at scale. Teams use Clay to power outbound, ABM, and CRM enrichment workflows, pulling from 150+ data providers and AI agents to get the most accurate, complete data possible.

Clay's integration with Attio lets you sync prospect and account data bidirectionally between both platforms. Import records from Attio or Attio lists into Clay to enrich and qualify them, then push the results back using actions like Create Record, Upsert Record, Update Record, and Lookup Records to keep your workspace clean, current, and ready for your GTM team to act on.
content.how_it_works: Connect Clay to Attio to sync enriched prospect and account data bidirectionally between both platforms. Pull records directly from Attio or Attio lists into Clay to enrich and qualify them using 150+ data providers and AI agents, then push the results back into Attio using actions like Create Record, Upsert Record, Update Record, and Lookup Records to keep your workspace accurate and up to date.
