- Click Sign in with Attio and authorize Clay to access your Attio workspace. Note that only Attio workspace admins can authorize this connection.
- Once connected, select your Attio account from the dropdown to start syncing records.

title: Apollo
short_description: Bring Apollo data into your agent blocks

content.overview:
Apollo is one of the largest B2B sales intelligence platforms, with verified data on more than 230 million contacts and 30 million companies. Sales, marketing, and revenue teams use it to find the right people, run outreach sequences, and track how their campaigns perform.

This app connects your Apollo account to Attio so you can use Apollo data inside your workflows. Drop an agent block into a workflow, give it access to Apollo, and it can search contacts, look up sequences and sending schedules, and read analytics as part of the flow.
content.how_it_works:
Add Apollo to an agent block in your workflows. When the workflow runs, the agent can pull live data from Apollo to inform what happens next.

Here's what it can read from Apollo:

- **Find people.** Search Apollo's database of 230M+ contacts.
- **Search your contacts.** Look through the contacts saved in your Apollo account.
- **Review sequences.** See your outreach sequences and how they're set up.
- **Check sending schedules.** See when sequences are set to send.
- **List email accounts.** See the email accounts connected to Apollo.
- **Read analytics.** Pull performance data on your outreach.
- **Track credit usage.** Check how many Apollo credits you've used.
- **View your profile.** Confirm which Apollo account is connected.

Every tool is read-only. The agent can see and use this information, but it can't edit, send, or delete anything in Apollo.
content.configure:
1. Install the app in Attio.
2. Click Connect and sign in to Apollo.
3. Authorize access.
4. Use Apollo MCP tools in your Custom Agent workflow blocks.

title: lemlist
short_description: Turn outreach into pipeline with lemlist + Attio

content.overview:
lemlist is an AI-powered sales engagement platform that lets sales and marketing teams send personalized cold emails, automate follow-ups, and run multi-channel campaigns. Teams use it to book meetings, nurture leads, and track campaign performance across the full outreach cycle.

This app connects your lemlist account to Attio so you can manage outreach directly from your CRM. Add leads to campaigns, track activity, and keep your contact records in sync — without switching tabs.
content.how_it_works:
Add lemlist to your workflows and record pages. When the integration is connected, you can act on contacts in Attio and push them straight into lemlist.

Here's what you can do from Attio:

- **Add to campaign**. Push a contact as a lead into any of your lemlist campaigns.
- **Bulk add to campaign**. Select multiple records and add them all at once.
- **Open in lemlist.** Jump directly to a contact's lemlist profile.
- **Find email.** Automatically find a verified email when adding a lead.
- **Find phone.** Find a phone number for the lead.
- **Verify email.** Run email verification via Debounce before adding.
- **Deduplicate.** Skip adding a lead if their email already exists in another campaign.
- **Social enrichment**. Trigger enrichment when adding a lead.
content.configure:
1. Install the app in Attio.

  2. Log into [lemlist](https://app.lemlist.com/) and click your profile picture (bottom left).

  3. Go to **Settings → Integrations**.

  4. Click **Generate a new API key** and copy it — you won't be able to see it again.

  5. Paste the API key into Attio when prompted.

title: Customer.io

content.how_it_works: Customer.io’s Attio destination creates or updates records for people, users, companies, and workspaces in Attio. This integration helps you keep your Attio workspace up-to-date with the latest information about your customers’ marketing engagement.
content.configure:

title: Google Sheets
short_description: Create, find, and update Google Sheets rows

content.overview:
Google Sheets is Google's spreadsheet tool for organizing and sharing tabular data. This integration connects your Attio workflows directly to Google Sheets, so you can create, find, and update spreadsheet rows automatically as records change in your CRM — without leaving Attio or building a manual export.

Connect any Google account with edit access to your spreadsheets, then reference a specific spreadsheet and tab from any workflow.
content.how_it_works:
Add a Google Sheets step to any Attio workflow:

- Create row: Append or prepend a new row to a sheet, with values for one or more columns.
- Find matching row: Locate the first row where selected columns match given values.
- Find matching rows: Locate every row where selected columns match given values.
- Find or create row: Find a matching row, or create a new one if none exists.
- Update row: Find a matching row and update one or more of its columns.

Columns can be referenced by their header name or by column letter (A, B, C...). Each step operates on the spreadsheet and tab you select when configuring the workflow.
content.configure:
1. Click your workspace name, select Workspace settings, then Apps in the sidebar.

2. Find the Google Sheets app and click Install.

3. Click + Connect — you'll be taken to Google OAuth to allow the requested scopes.

4. Once connected, add a Google Sheets step to any workflow, select the spreadsheet and tab it should read from or write to, and configure which columns to match, create, or update.

title: Hunter

title: Polytomic
short_description: One platform to sync to and from Attio

content.overview: Connect Attio to Polytomic to enable two-way syncing between your Attio data and your data warehouses, cloud applications, databases, spreadsheets, and APIs.

- ETL: Sync your Attio workspace to your data warehouse.
- Reverse-ETL: Sync your data warehouse to your Attio workspace.
- Data enrichment: You can enrich data in Attio or your warehouse with data from Apollo, and a number of other enrichment providers.

- Pull in product data: Power Attio with insights from your product databases.
content.configure:
Polytomic connects to Attio using OAuth. Please ensure that the Attio user account you are connecting with has all the required read/write permissions within Attio to the objects you care about.

1. In Polytomic, go to **Connections > Add Connection > Attio**.
2. Click **Connect to Attio** to go through Attio’s authentication flow. You’ll authenticate using an existing Attio user account.

title: Aanrich

Aanrich is a contact enrichment app for Attio CRM that helps sales and revenue teams find verified professional emails and phone numbers without leaving their workspace.  Install in seconds, get 5 free credits, and start turning incomplete contacts into actionable leads.

Install Aanrich from Attio "Apps and integrations" it takes less than a minute. Once installed, open any Person record and click the "Find email and phone" action. Aanrich searches multiple data sources in real time and automatically adds verified contact information to the record. 

For best results, make sure your Person has a first name, last name, and either a company with a domain or a LinkedIn URL. No exports, no imports, no tab switching - everything happens directly in Attio.

title: Airtable
short_description: Integrate your Airtable data with Attio workflows

content.overview:
Airtable is a database and app platform used by over 500,000 teams. Bases hold your tables, records, and fields, and interfaces turn that data into views people use day to day.

This app connects Airtable to Attio so your workflows can read it. An agent block can find the right base, pull the records it needs, and use them as context, without anyone leaving Attio.
content.how_it_works:

- **Read the structure.** Pull a table's schema and fields, and list the interfaces and pages built on a base.
- **Pull records.** Search records in a table, fetch a set of records for analysis, or read records from an interface page.

Every tool is read-only. The agent can look things up and reason over them, but it never writes back to Airtable.
content.configure:
1. Install the app.
2. Click **Connect** and sign in to Airtable.
3. Approve the access request.

Once connected, add the Airtable tools to an agent block in any workflow.

title: SyncPenguin

title: MATAGI
short_description: Auto-enrich your Attio with Matagi research agents

content.overview:
MATAGI lets you deploy cutting-edge autonomous research agents directly inside Attio.

These agents act like always-on analysts that help you research companies, prepare data, and keep your pipeline up to date. Instead of manually gathering information or building complex workflows, you can simply define what you want to know and let the agent handle the research.

Whether you're enriching records, preparing data for outreach, investigating companies, or organizing insights across your pipeline, Matagi agents continuously gather information and turn it into structured data inside your CRM.

There are no rigid templates or predefined use cases. You describe the challenge, and the agent figures out how to solve it.

Most teams start with a simple task and quickly realize the agent can handle far more. The best way to understand the power of Matagi is to deploy an agent and let it start working on your research, enrichment, and data preparation challenges.
content.how_it_works:
Matagi agents are autonomous research agents with full access to your Attio workspace, the public web, and thousands of external tools. They can join your team as virtual team-members.

Once connected, an agent can read and update records, investigate companies online, gather information from multiple sources, and trigger actions across your stack. Matagi integrates with more than 3000 tools out of the box, allowing agents to move data, generate insights, and coordinate workflows automatically.

Unlike traditional automation tools, Matagi agents don't rely on rigid workflows. They interpret the task you give them, plan the research steps, gather the necessary information, and return structured results directly to your Attio records.

The entire system is designed to work without technical setup. In most cases, you can deploy a fully capable research agent and start assigning tasks in under two minutes.
content.configure:

Agents can receive instructions from:

- Attio
- Slack
- Telegram
- Discord
- Matagi web chat

Once deployed, the agent is ready for assignments from you, you can also give it autonomous grooming or research tasks that it runs asynchronously.

title: Octolens
short_description: Social listening signals, right inside Attio workflows

content.overview:
[Octolens](https://octolens.com/) is the AI-powered social listening platform, used by Vercel, PostHog, Supabase, and 1000+ other teams.

It monitors all relevant platforms for B2B conversations, including [Reddit](https://octolens.com/reddit-monitoring), [X/Twitter](https://octolens.com/twitter-monitoring), LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky, Hacker News, GitHub, news, podcasts, and more.

Every mention is scored by AI for relevance, sentiment and buying intent, so you act on signal instead of noise.

This app brings social signals into Attio's workflows. Start an automation the moment a relevant mention appears, or pull a person's mentions on demand — then create records, enrich contacts, add timeline notes, notify your team, or anything else you can build in Attio. You decide how the data maps to your CRM, Octolens supplies the signal.
content.configure:
## Requirements

- An Octolens account (any plan).
- Admin access to your Attio workspace to install the app.

## Setup

1. In Octolens, go to Settings → [API keys](https://app.octolens.com/me/api) and create a key with Read + Write scope. *Read* lets the app fetch your mentions; *Write* lets the "New Octolens mention" trigger attach a webhook to the view you choose. Octolens never holds an Attio token and makes no changes to your data on its own. You stay in control of every write.
2. In Attio, install the Octolens app and paste the key into the Octolens connection.
3. Add the Octolens trigger or any step to a workflow and configure it.

*Tip: link people by social handle, not company name. The author step matches on X handle and LinkedIn profile URL — deterministic identifiers you can map directly from your Attio Person records.*

title: reodotdev
short_description: Two-way sync to keep Reo and Attio data always up to date

content.overview: [Reo.Dev](http://reo.dev/) is an AI-powered Revenue Intelligence Platform built to help DevTool teams unlock hidden revenue opportunities and close deals faster. By capturing real-time buying signals, enriching account data, and delivering AI-driven insights, [Reo.Dev](http://reo.dev/) ensures your sales and marketing teams focus on the right accounts at the right time - without guesswork.
content.how_it_works:

short_description: Review and merge companies with related domains

content.overview:
Subdomain Merge finds company records that share a root domain or use its subdomains. An optional mode also suggests matching domain names across extensions, such as example.com and example.net.

Every candidate shows company names, full domains, populated attribute counts and the proposed primary. Cross-extension matches always warn that domain ownership may differ. Verify that all companies belong to the same organization before merging.

content.how_it_works:
Open Companies and choose Scan subdomain duplicates from the object actions menu. The initial scan finds records sharing the same root domain. Select Include other extensions to also compare identical domain names across extensions, including suffixes such as .co.uk. Select Subdomains only to return to the standard scan.

Shared platforms, invalid domains and records spanning unrelated domain names are excluded. Name mismatches and primary conflicts appear as review warnings. Similar spelling alone is never used to suggest a match.

Select Change primary if needed, then Merge records. The confirmation explains which company will be primary and warns again when extensions differ. Primary values win conflicts.

After the merge, open the final company to check its preserved domains and activity. A new scan is required before another merge.
content.configure:

title: Knock2
short_description: Turn anonymous website traffic into sales-ready leads

content.overview: Knock2 identifies the companies and people visiting your website, scores them against your Ideal Customer Profile, and turns that buying intent into Attio records your team already works in. content.how_it_works:

- **Push qualified contacts to Attio.** Add an Attio destination to any Knock2 Play or Workflow. Matching contacts are created or updated as Attio **People** records, matched by email. No manual data entry, no duplicate records.
- **Pull deal context back from Attio.** When a visitor's company domain matches an existing Attio Company, Knock2 reads that company's deals — stage, value, owner, close date — and surfaces them on the visitor's record inside Knock2.
- **Map your own Attio fields.** Choose which Attio attributes (standard or custom) appear in Knock2's Contacts and Accounts views, so the data you see matches how your team actually uses Attio.
- **Permissions.** Knock2 writes People records and reads Company/Deal data. It does not create, edit, or delete Attio Deals, Workspaces, or Users.
content.configure:
1. In Knock2, go to **Settings → App Marketplace** and select **Attio**.
2. Click **Connect** and authorize Knock2 in the Attio sign-in screen. This creates one connection for your whole Attio workspace — any teammate can complete this step, but reconnecting later requires repeating this flow.
3. Open the Attio integration drawer's **Read** tab and select which Attio attributes you want visible inside Knock2. Only attributes that still exist in your workspace can be selected.

title: CheckRedirects
short_description: Resolve URLs before they create duplicate records

content.overview:
CheckRedirects helps keep domain-based records in Attio clean and up to date.

It follows redirects for company domains, email domains, or any custom object with a domain field. That makes it useful for spotting duplicate companies, rebrands, acquisitions, and dead domains.

The app adds two Workflow blocks to Attio. It does not read, write, merge, or modify records itself. You decide what Attio should do with the result.
content.how_it_works:
CheckRedirects adds two Attio Workflow blocks:

- **Resolve Domain:** checks a domain or URL and returns where it ultimately resolves.
- **Resolve Email Domain:** extracts the root domain from an email address and checks that website.

Use them when records are created or on a recurring schedule to spot redirects, rebrands, acquisitions, dead domains, and possible duplicates.

Each check follows up to 10 redirects and returns the final domain, final URL, redirect count, and a report link. It also surfaces DNS, TLS, HTTP, and redirect errors so you can route failures separately.

**Domain changed** is only true when the registered domain actually changes. www.acme.com → acme.com or acme.com → app.acme.com does not count; acme.com → bigcorp.com does.
content.configure:
1. Sign up at checkredirects.io and create an API key.

2. Install the app in your Attio workspace.

3. Click "Add connection" and paste just the API key.

4. Add Resolve Domain or Resolve Email Domain to a workflow and set its input.

There are no other app settings. API access is included on all CheckRedirects plans. Each block run uses one check.

title: CVR Pilot

Companies already in your Attio workspace are excluded from future searches, so the same company is never delivered to you twice.
content.configure:

title: Gojiberry

title: Phano

title: SpecStream
short_description: Live web data in Attio, with a source for every value

content.overview:
SpecStream brings live web data into Attio. Describe the companies or people you want in plain words, like every private company in Texas that filed to raise money this month, or every agency in Leeds hiring a developer, and get structured records read from the live web, each value with the page it came from.

They land in Attio as companies or people with only the attributes you map, and can join a list. Keep a request running and new and changed records arrive on their own.
content.how_it_works:
SpecStream reads the live web for the companies and people you describe and sends them to Attio as records.

- Ask in plain words, as specific as you like: "US startups that filed a Form D for $5M or more this week", "B2B SaaS companies in Berlin hiring their first Head of Sales".
- Every value arrives with the page it came from, so anyone on your team can open the source.
- Map each detail to your own attributes, in Attio's names. Details you don't map aren't sent.
- Add the batch to a list, so new records are easy to find.
- Turn on Keep sending and new and changed records arrive on their own, with the same mapping.

Before it creates anything, SpecStream looks for the record in Attio: companies by domain, people by an email address the source published. A match is updated or left alone, as you choose. A result that matches more than one record isn't written, so no duplicates appear. SpecStream only writes records: it never sends email or enrolls anyone in a sequence.
content.configure:
### Install

1. Install SpecStream from the Attio App Store and approve access to records, objects and lists.
2. Sign in to SpecStream, or create an account (free to start, no card).
3. Confirm the Attio workspace being connected. Nothing connects until you do.

### Send records

1. Open a collection in SpecStream, select results, open Export and choose Attio under Send to.
2. Choose companies or people, what happens when Attio already has the record, and an optional list.

6. Sync status and errors can be monitored from the Central dashboard.

Central supports automated CRM synchronization workflows and bi-directional data updates across integrated systems.

title: UseReviews
short_description: Turn customer feedback into insights tied to every person

content.overview:
UseReviews is a voice-of-customer platform for SaaS teams. It pulls in customer feedback from reviews, surveys, support conversations and in-app widgets, uses AI to turn it into insights (churn signals, bug reports, feature requests, competitor mentions and advocates) and ties every piece of feedback to the person who gave it.

The Attio app puts that evidence where your team already works. Each company and person in Attio shows what customers are saying and how they use your product, so account owners can see churn risk, open requests and advocates without leaving their CRM.
content.configure:
You need a UseReviews workspace and the Owner or Admin role to connect Attio.

1. In UseReviews, go to Settings → Integrations and click Connect Attio.
2. Approve access to your Attio workspace.
3. Optionally, choose which Attio attributes hold MRR (and whether it’s monthly or annual), plan, renewal date and lifecycle stage.
4. Switch off any write-back attribute or timeline note type you don’t want. Changes apply from the next sync.

To disconnect, go to Settings → Integrations in UseReviews. This deletes the stored tokens and removes the webhook UseReviews registered in Attio. The usereviews\_ attributes stay on your records with their last values, and notes already added stay on the timeline; you can delete them in Attio. The app stays installed in Attio, so uninstall it there if you don’t plan to reconnect.
